library WINTrigVictoryorDefeat requires FXRD

    globals
        private tick array resulTick
        private tick array saveTick
    endglobals
    
    private function OnSave takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer id = tick.getExpired().data
        call SaveData.encode( Player(id) )
    endfunction
    
    private function OnResult takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer id = tick.getExpired().data
        local UIResult myRes = UIResult.create( 0, Player(id), 0, 0, 0 )
        set myRes.xp_base = WIN_BASE[id]
        set myRes.xp_add = WIN_ADD[id]
        set myRes.xp_final = WIN_FINAL[id]
        set myRes.cur_xp = WIN_XP[id]
        set myRes.cur_level = WIN_LV[id]
        set myRes.max_level = FXGetPlayerLevel( Player(id) )
        set myRes.max_xp = FXGetPlayerXp( Player(id) )
        if WIN_MASTER[id] != USER_IS_MASTER[id] then
            set myRes.max_level = 15
            set myRes.max_xp = 0
        endif
        set myRes.mastered = WIN_MASTER[id]
        call myRes.show( true )
    endfunction
    
    function FXRDVictory takes player p, boolean isVictory returns nothing
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
        local integer axp = 0
        // 이미 승리 중이라면 자르기
        if FXRD_RESULTED[id] then
            return
        endif
        set FXRD_VICTORY[id] = isVictory
        set FXRD_RESULTED[id] = true
        //
        if GetPlayerSlotState(p) == PLAYER_SLOT_STATE_LEFT then
            return
        endif
        if GetPlayerController(p) != MAP_CONTROL_USER then
            return
        endif
        // 스피드런 모드
        if MODE_CURRENT == MODE_SPEEDRUN and isVictory then
            set FXRD_CLEAR_TIME[id] = playtime.current
            call statusBoard.finishWave( p )
        endif
        //협동 모드
        if MODE_CURRENT == MODE_TEAM and isVictory then
            set USER_XP_BONUS[id] = USER_XP_BONUS[id] + R2I(50 * CountInGameUser() / 4)
        endif
        // 기타 모드
        set UI_ENABLED[id] = true
        set WIN_MASTER[id] = FXIsPlayerCurrentFactionMastered(p)
        set WIN_LV[id] = FXGetPlayerLevel(p)
        set WIN_XP[id] = FXGetPlayerXp(p)
        set WIN_ENABLED[id] = true
        set WIN_XP_ADD[id] = 0
        if isVictory then
            set WIN_BASE[id] = LEVEL_XP[LEVEL_CURRENT]
            set WIN_ADD[id] = WIN_BASE[id] * USER_XP_BONUS[id] / 100
            set WIN_FINAL[id] = WIN_BASE[id] + WIN_ADD[id]
            set axp = WIN_FINAL[id]
        else
            //경험치 보너스 손실
            set USER_XP_BONUS[id] = 0
            set WIN_ADD[id] = 0
            //진행한 라운드 비례 50% 보상
            set axp = LEVEL_WAVE[LEVEL_CURRENT] / 2
            debug call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "임계 라운드 = "+I2S(axp))
            set axp = IMaxBJ(0,GetUserWave(p) - axp) * 50 / axp
            debug call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "경험치 보너스 비율 = "+I2S(axp))
            set axp = LEVEL_XP[LEVEL_CURRENT] * axp / 100
            set WIN_BASE[id] = axp
            set WIN_FINAL[id] = axp
        endif
        //경험치 부여
        debug call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "획득한 경험치 = "+I2S(axp))
        call FXAddPlayerXp( p, axp )
        debug call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "[경험치 부여 완료]")
        set USER_IS_MASTER[id] = FXIsPlayerCurrentFactionMastered(p)
        //플레이타임 누적
        set FXRD_CLEAR_TIME[id] = playtime.current
        set DATA_PLAYTIME[id] = DATA_PLAYTIME[id] + R2I(FXRD_CLEAR_TIME[id]/60)
        //세이브코드 작성
        if GAME_IS_ONLINE then
            call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "|c00FF8000※알림 : 10초 후에 세이브코드가 저장됩니다|r")
            call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "|c00FFFF00※알림 : 지금 나가면 경험치를 획득할 수 없습니다|r")
            if saveTick[id] == 0 then
                set saveTick[id] = tick.create(id)
            endif
            call saveTick[id].start( 10.00, false, function OnSave )
        else
            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,60,"|c00ff8000알림 : 오프라인 커스텀 게임 플레이에서는 업적을 저장할 수 없습니다.|r")
            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,60,"|c00ff8000알림 : 불편하시더라도 LAN 또는 Battle.net에서 즐겨주세요.|r")
            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,60,"|c000080ff정보 : LAN에서 진행하는 싱글 플레이는 업적이 저장됩니다.|r")
        endif
        set WIN_XP_BASE[id] = 0
        set WIN_XP_CHAL[id] = 0
        //결과창 출력
        if resulTick[id] == 0 then
            set resulTick[id] = tick.create(id)
        endif
        call resulTick[id].start( 10.00, false, function OnResult )
    endfunction
endlibrary

        call .if_bgr.destroy()
        call RemoveDestructable( img_indicator )
        call RemoveDestructable( img_msg )
        set img_indicator = null
        set img_msg = null
    endmethod
    method show takes boolean flag returns nothing
        call ShowDestructable( img_indicator, flag )
        call ShowDestructable( img_msg, flag )
    endmethod

        //Union 객체로 할당

scope UIGameLoadingModule initializer main
    globals
        private UIGameLoading singleton = 0
    endglobals
    private function onGameSet takes nothing returns nothing
        if singleton == 0 then
            return
        endif
        call singleton.destroy()
        set singleton = 0
    endfunction
    private function onMapInitialized takes nothing returns nothing
        if singleton == 0 then
            return
        endif
        call singleton.show(false)
    endfunction
    private function onMapInitializing takes nothing returns nothing
        if singleton > 0 then
            call singleton.destroy()
        endif
        set singleton = UIGameLoading.create()
    endfunction
    private function main takes nothing returns nothing
        call RRRegisterResponseEvent(RESPONSE_MAP_INITIALIZING, function onMapInitializing)
        call RRRegisterResponseEvent(RESPONSE_MAP_INITIALIZED, function onMapInitialized)
        call RRRegisterResponseEvent(RESPONSE_GAME_SET, function onGameSet)
    endfunction
endscope

    struct DecodeEvent extends array
        private static trigger array T
        static Savecode e
        static player ep
        static method register takes integer ver, code c returns nothing
            if T[ver] == null then
                set T[ver] = CreateTrigger()
            endif
            call TriggerAddCondition( T[ver], Filter( c ) )
        endmethod
        static method evaluate takes player p, Savecode w, integer ver returns nothing
            set e = w
            set ep = p
            call TriggerEvaluate( T[ver] )
            set e = 0
            set ep = null
        endmethod
    endstruct
    
    struct Decoder extends array
        private static method onInit takes nothing returns nothing
            //이전 버전 호환
            call DecodeEvent.register( 0, function thistype.DECS00000 ) /* 3.72 이전 4세력 */
            //최신 버전
            call DecodeEvent.register( 1, function thistype.DECS00001 ) /* 3.75 5세력 */
        endmethod
        
        /* 최신 버전 */
        private static method DECS00001 takes nothing returns nothing
            //이 버전에서 특기할 사항
            local integer FACTION_MAX_THISVER = 5
            local integer FACTION_MAX_LEVEL_THISVER = 15
            local integer FACTION_XP_LIMIT_THISVER = 130000

            local integer MASTER_XP_LIMIT_THISVER = 1035000

            //
            local integer id = GetPlayerId(DecodeEvent.ep)
            local Savecode theCode = DecodeEvent.e
            //-상하키-
            local integer upperkey = theCode.Decode( 10 )
            local integer lowerkey = theCode.Decode( 9 )
            //-끝-
            local integer array factionXp
            local integer array factionLv
            local integer masterXp
            local integer masterLv
            local integer playTime
            local integer session
            
            //-주 데이터-
            
            set factionXp[5] = theCode.Decode( FACTION_XP_LIMIT_THISVER )
            set factionXp[4] = theCode.Decode( FACTION_XP_LIMIT_THISVER )
            set factionXp[3] = theCode.Decode( FACTION_XP_LIMIT_THISVER )
            set factionXp[2] = theCode.Decode( FACTION_XP_LIMIT_THISVER )
            set factionXp[1] = theCode.Decode( FACTION_XP_LIMIT_THISVER )

            set factionLv[4] = theCode.Decode( FACTION_MAX_LEVEL_THISVER )
            set factionLv[3] = theCode.Decode( FACTION_MAX_LEVEL_THISVER )
            set factionLv[2] = theCode.Decode( FACTION_MAX_LEVEL_THISVER )
            set factionLv[1] = theCode.Decode( FACTION_MAX_LEVEL_THISVER )
            set masterXp = theCode.Decode( MASTER_XP_LIMIT_THISVER )
            set masterLv = theCode.Decode( MASTER_MAX_LEVEL_THISVER )
            set playTime = theCode.Decode( 599940 )
            set session = theCode.Decode( 1 )
            
            //-최후 검증-

            //최후 검증까지 무사했다면...

                    call FXSetPlayerFactionXp( Player(id), fIndex, factionXp[fIndex] )

                set fIndex = fIndex + 1

        endmethod

    struct SaveData extends array
        //세이브데이터 코어
        private static constant integer SAVEHASH = 180125
        
        static method encodeFaction takes player p, Savecode myCode returns nothing
            local integer fIndex = 1
            loop
                exitwhen fIndex > FX_FACTION_MAX
                call myCode.Encode( FXGetPlayerFactionLevel(p,fIndex), FX_FACTION_MAX_LEVEL )
                set fIndex = fIndex + 1
            endloop
            set fIndex = 1
            loop
                exitwhen fIndex > FX_FACTION_MAX
                call myCode.Encode( FXGetPlayerFactionXp(p,fIndex), FX_FACTION_LIMIT_XP )
                set fIndex = fIndex + 1
            endloop
        endmethod
        
        static method encode takes player p returns nothing
            local string codeStr
            local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
            local string oName = USER_NAME[id]
            local boolean saveEnable = true
            local string prefix
            local Savecode myCode = Savecode.create()
            local integer upperkey = 7
            local integer lowerkey = 7
            //닉네임 짧으면 덧대기
            if StringLength(oName) < 5 then
                set oName = "lo"+oName
            endif
            //최하키 기록
            call myCode.Encode( lowerkey, upperkey )
            //-데이터 기록부-
            call myCode.Encode( IMinBJ(MAP_SESSION, DATA_SESSION[id]), 1 )
            call myCode.Encode( DATA_PLAYTIME[id], 599940 )
            call myCode.Encode( FXGetPlayerMasterLevel(p), FX_MASTER_MAX_LEVEL )
            call myCode.Encode( FXGetPlayerMasterXp(p), FX_MASTER_LIMIT_XP )
            call encodeFaction( p, myCode )
            //-끝-
            
            //상하키 기록
            call myCode.Encode( lowerkey, 9 )
            call myCode.Encode( upperkey, 10 )
            //버전 기록
            call myCode.Encode( MAP_VERSION, MAP_MAX_VERSION )
            
            set codeStr = myCode.Save( oName, SAVEHASH )
            
            if not USER_IS_FIRSTPLAY[id] then
                set oName = "SaveCode_"+I2S(MAP_VERSION)+"_"+I2S(StringHash(USER_NAME[id]))
                set prefix = "페이트 엑스트라 랜덤 디펜스를 이어서 플레이했던 세이브 파일입니다."
            else
                set oName = "NewSave_"+I2S(MAP_VERSION)+"_"+I2S(StringHash(USER_NAME[id]))
                set prefix = "페이트 엑스트라 랜덤 디펜스를 처음 플레이하신 세이브 파일입니다."
            endif
            if IMinBJ(MAP_SESSION,DATA_SESSION[id]) == 0 then
                set oName = "CHT"+oName
                set prefix = "[비공식]"+prefix
            endif
            set FXGameResult[id].LastSaveCode = codeStr
            call myCode.destroy()
            
            if GetLocalPlayer() != p then
                set saveEnable = false
            endif
            if GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer()) != MAP_INITIAL_USER then
                set saveEnable = false
            endif
            
            call showCodeQuest( p, codeStr, saveEnable )
            if saveEnable then
                call DisplayTextToPlayer( p, 0.00, 0.00, "|c000080ff자동 저장되었습니다|r" )
                call FlashQuestDialogButton()
                call PreloadGenClear()
                call PreloadGenStart()
                call Preload("<페이트 엑스트라 랜덤 디펜스 파이널 시즌 업적 데이터입니다>")
                call Preload("세이브 버전: "+I2S(MAP_VERSION))
                call Preload(prefix)
                call Preload("==================================================================")
                call Preload("워크 닉네임 "+USER_NAME[id])
                call Preload("플레이 타임 "+I2S(DATA_PLAYTIME[id]/60)+"h "+I2S(ModuloInteger(DATA_PLAYTIME[id],60))+"m")
                call Preload(" [마스터 정보]")
                call Preload("  - 마스터 레벨 : "+I2S(FXGetPlayerMasterLevel(p)))
                call Preload("  - 마스터 XP : "+I2S(FXGetPlayerMasterXp(p)))
                call Preload(" [세력 정보]")
                call Preload("  네로 클라우디우스")
                call Preload("   - 레벨 : "+I2S(FXGetPlayerFactionLevel(p,FX_FACTION_NERO)))
                call Preload("   - XP : "+I2S(FXGetPlayerFactionXp(p,FX_FACTION_NERO)))
                call Preload("  타마모노마에")
                call Preload("   - 레벨 : "+I2S(FXGetPlayerFactionLevel(p,FX_FACTION_TAMAMO)))
                call Preload("   - XP : "+I2S(FXGetPlayerFactionXp(p,FX_FACTION_TAMAMO)))
                call Preload("  알테라")
                call Preload("   - 레벨 : "+I2S(FXGetPlayerFactionLevel(p,FX_FACTION_ALTERA)))
                call Preload("   - XP : "+I2S(FXGetPlayerFactionXp(p,FX_FACTION_ALTERA)))
                call Preload("  어나더")
                call Preload("   - 레벨 : "+I2S(FXGetPlayerFactionLevel(p,FX_FACTION_ANOTHER)))
                call Preload("   - XP : "+I2S(FXGetPlayerFactionXp(p,FX_FACTION_ANOTHER)))
                call Preload("  BB")

                call Preload("   - XP : "+I2S(FXGetPlayerFactionXp(p,FX_FACTION_BB)))
                call Preload("==================================================================")
                call PreloadSaveCode("-load "+codeStr)
                call Preload("코드 사용법 : 채팅창에 위 코드(명령어)를 Ctrl+C로 복사하신 다음 워크래프트 채팅창에 Ctrl+V로 붙여넣으세요.")
                call PreloadGenEnd("Fate Extra Random Defence\\" + oName + ".txt")
            else
                call DisplayTextToPlayer( p, 0.00, 0.00, "|c00ff8000리플레이 모드에서는 타인의 세이브코드가 생성되지 않습니다!|r" )
            endif
        endmethod
        //

            call QuestSetTitle(q, "보기 - 세이브 코드")
            call QuestSetDescription(q, codeStr)
            if FXIsPlayerFactionMastered(p,myFaction) then
                call QuestSetIconPath(q, FXGetFactionMasterIcon(myFaction))
            else
                call QuestSetIconPath(q, FXGetFactionIcon(myFaction))
            endif
            call QuestSetRequired( q, true )
            call QuestSetDiscovered( q, saveEnable )
            call QuestSetEnabled( q, saveEnable )
            set q = null
        endmethod
        //
        static method decode takes player p, string codeStr returns nothing
            local Savecode theCode = Savecode.create()
            local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
            local string oName = USER_NAME[id]
            local integer ver
            //에러가 떴음을 기정사실화
            set UI_ERROR[id] = true

                debug call DisplayTextToPlayer( p, 0.00, 0.00, "|c00ff4040올바르지 못한 코드입니다" )
                call theCode.destroy()
                if StringLength(oName) < 5 then

                endif
                set theCode = Savecode.create()
                if not theCode.Load( oName, codeStr, SAVEHASH ) then
                    call theCode.destroy()
                    return
                endif
            endif
            set ver = theCode.Decode( MAP_MAX_VERSION )
            debug call DisplayTextToPlayer( p, 0.00, 0.00, "|c000080ff불러올 코드의 버전: " + I2S(ver) )

    private static method DestroyPlayerUI takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer i = 0
        local integer f
        loop
            exitwhen i == 4
            call num_lv[i].destroy()
            call num_xp[i].destroy()
            call RemoveDestructable(spr_dock[i])
            set spr_dock[i] = null
            set f = 1
            loop

            endloop
            set i = i + 1
        endloop

    private method RefreshMilestone takes player p returns nothing

    private function SPPseudoSelectReadyButton takes player p returns nothing
        local fxFaction myFaction = FXGetPlayerCurrentFaction( p )
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
        local integer i = 0
        if not GAME_IS_SETTING then
            return
        endif
        if myFaction >= FX_FACTION_ANOTHER and not FXIsPlayerMaster(p) then
            //SOUND : ERROR
            call StartSoundForPlayerBJ( p, gg_snd_Error )
            return
        endif
        set UI_READY[id] = not UI_READY[id]
        call singleton.RefreshPlayer(p)
        set GAME_IS_SETTING = false
        loop
            exitwhen i == 4
            if IsPlayerPlaying( Player(i) ) and not UI_READY[i] then
                set GAME_IS_SETTING = true
                return
            endif
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
        call SetCineFilterTexture("Textures\\Black32.blp")
        call SetCineFilterBlendMode(BLEND_MODE_BLEND)
        call SetCineFilterTexMapFlags(TEXMAP_FLAG_NONE)
        call SetCineFilterStartUV(0,0,1,1)
        call SetCineFilterEndUV(0,0,1,1)
        call SetCineFilterStartColor(255,255,255,255)
        call SetCineFilterEndColor(255,255,255,255)
        call SetCineFilterDuration(0)
        call DisplayCineFilter(true)
        call TimerStart(CreateTimer(), 0.50, false, function onAllReady)
    endfunction

scope TrigSvAutoAlign initializer main
    globals
        private trigger COMMAND = CreateTrigger()
        private hashtable H = InitHashtable()
        private group G = CreateGroup()
        private integer array IND
        private integer CNT = 0
        private real X
        private real Y
    endglobals
    
    private function RegisterCommandTrigger takes code c returns nothing
        local integer i = 0
        call TriggerAddAction(COMMAND,c)
        loop
            exitwhen i == bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS
            call TriggerRegisterPlayerChatEvent(COMMAND,Player(i),"-정렬",true)
            call TriggerRegisterPlayerChatEvent(COMMAND,Player(i),"-ㅈ",true)
            call TriggerRegisterPlayerChatEvent(COMMAND,Player(i),"-wjdfuf",true)
            call TriggerRegisterPlayerChatEvent(COMMAND,Player(i),"-w",true)
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
    endfunction
    /*===========================================================================*/
    
    private function onFilter takes nothing returns boolean
        local integer pos = 0
        local integer lev
        if IsUnitDead( GetFilterUnit() ) then
            return false
        endif
        if not IsUnitType( GetFilterUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_TAUREN ) then
            return false
        endif
        if IsUnitType(GetFilterUnit(),UNIT_TYPE_HERO) then
            return false
        endif
        set lev = GetUnitLevel( GetFilterUnit() )
        if lev > 3 then
            return false
        endif
        set pos = LoadInteger( H, 0, GetUnitTypeId(GetFilterUnit()) )
        if pos == 0 then
            if IND[lev] > 31 then
                return false
            endif
            set IND[lev] = IND[lev] + 1
            set pos = IND[lev]
            call SaveInteger( H, 0, GetUnitTypeId(GetFilterUnit()), pos )
        endif
        set pos = pos - 1
        call SetUnitPosition( GetFilterUnit(), X+128*ModuloInteger(pos,13), Y-128*I2R(pos/13+(lev-1)) )
        call IssueImmediateOrder( GetFilterUnit(), "holdposition" )
        return false
    endfunction
    
    private function doAlign takes player p returns nothing
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
        call FlushChildHashtable( H, 0 )
        set IND[0] = 0
        set IND[1] = 0
        set IND[2] = 0
        set IND[3] = 0
        set X = GetPlayerStartLocationX(Player(id+4)) - 768
        set Y = GetPlayerStartLocationY(Player(id+4)) - 128
        call GroupEnumUnitsOfPlayer( G, p, Filter( function onFilter ) )
        call GroupClear( G )
        call DisplayTextToPlayer( p, 0.0, 0.0, "|c000080ffC급 이하 서번트가 정리되었습니다|r" )
    endfunction
    
    private function onAlign takes nothing returns nothing
        call doAlign(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))
    endfunction
    
    private function onChatAlign takes nothing returns nothing
        call doAlign(GetTriggerPlayer())
    endfunction
    
    private function main takes nothing returns nothing
        call RegisterCommandTrigger(function onChatAlign)
        call AbilityEffectEvent.Create( 'A03O', function onAlign )
    endfunction
endscope

    private function onUIClose takes nothing returns nothing

        set ui:NUM = InterfaceNumpad.create( p, 5350 + 96, 16.00, path, 0.0 )

        call ShowDestructable( ui:BACKDROP_BONUS, false )

        set ui:MILESTONE = CreateDestructableZ( 'B007', 5408.0+64.0, 64.0-192.0, 0.0, 270, 1.5, 0 )

        call ShowDestructable( ui:MILESTONE_MAX, false )
        
        set p = null

        local GameResponse res = RRGetResponse()
        local player p = res.Player
        local integer ui = GetPlayerId(p)
        local FXResultInterface parent = FXResultInterface[ui]
        local boolean isMastered = parent.CurPlayerMastered
        local boolean isMaxed = isMastered and (parent.CurPlayerLevel == FX_MASTER_MAX_LEVEL)
        local boolean isVisible = parent.Visible
        
        local integer xpcap
        if isMastered then
            set xpcap = FXGetMasterXpReq(parent.CurPlayerLevel)
        else
            set xpcap = FXGetXpReq(parent.CurPlayerLevel)
        endif
        
        set ui:NUM_XP.text = I2S(parent.CurPlayerXP) + "S" + I2S(xpcap)
        set ui:NUM_LV.text = I2S(parent.CurPlayerLevel)
        
        set ui:NUM_BASE.text = I2S(parent.CurXPBase)
        set ui:NUM_BONUS.text = I2S(parent.CurXPBonus)
        set ui:NUM.text = I2S(parent.CurXP)
        
        if GetLocalPlayer() == p then
            call ShowDestructable( ui:BACKDROP_BASE, isVisible )
            call ShowDestructable( ui:BACKDROP_BONUS, isVisible )
            call ShowDestructable( ui:BACKDROP, isVisible )
            if isMastered then
                call ShowDestructable( ui:MILESTONE, false )
                call ShowDestructable( ui:MILESTONE_MASTER, not isMaxed )
                call ShowDestructable( ui:MILESTONE_MAX, isMaxed )
            else
                call ShowDestructable( ui:MILESTONE, true )
                call ShowDestructable( ui:MILESTONE_MASTER, false )
                call ShowDestructable( ui:MILESTONE_MAX, false )
            endif
        endif
        
        set p = null

scope UIResultCalcEffect initializer main

    globals
        private tick array TICK
    endglobals

    private function onClosing takes nothing returns nothing
        local GameResponse res = RRGetResponse()
        local player p = res.Player
        local integer ui = GetPlayerId(p)
        
        if GetLocalPlayer() == Player(ui) then
            call StopSound(gg_snd_XP_UP,false,false)
        endif
            
        call ui:TICK.destroy()
        
        set p = null
    endfunction
    
    private function CallBackStat takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer ui = tick.getExpired().data
        local FXResultInterface parent = FXResultInterface[ui]
        
        local integer xpmax
        
        local boolean gainingRequired = true
        if parent.CurPlayerLevel >= parent.PlayerLevel then
            if parent.CurPlayerXP >= parent.PlayerXP then
                set gainingRequired = false
            endif
        endif
        
        if not gainingRequired then
            call ui:TICK.pause()
            if GetLocalPlayer() == Player(ui) then
                call StopSound(gg_snd_XP_UP,false,false)
            endif
            if GetLocalPlayer() == Player(ui) then
                call StopSound(gg_snd_LEVEL_UP,false,false)
            endif
            if parent.Result == FXGameResult.Victory then
                call StartSoundForPlayerBJ(Player(ui),gg_snd_XP_GAIN_DONE)
                call StartSoundForPlayerBJ(Player(ui),gg_snd_GAME_VICTORY)
            else
                call StartSoundForPlayerBJ(Player(ui),gg_snd_GAME_DEFEAT)
            endif
        endif
        
        if parent.CurPlayerMastered then
            set xpmax = FXGetMasterXpReq(parent.CurPlayerLevel)
        else
            set xpmax = FXGetXpReq(parent.CurPlayerLevel)
        endif
        
        if parent.CurPlayerLevel >= parent.PlayerLevel then
            set xpmax = parent.PlayerXP
            set parent.CurPlayerXP = IMinBJ(parent.CurPlayerXP+1000,xpmax)
        else
            set parent.CurPlayerXP = IMinBJ(parent.CurPlayerXP+1000,xpmax)
            if parent.CurPlayerXP == xpmax then
                set parent.CurPlayerLevel = parent.CurPlayerLevel + 1
                set parent.CurPlayerXP = 0
                if GetLocalPlayer() == Player(ui) then
                    call StopSound(gg_snd_LEVEL_UP,false,false)
                endif
                call StartSoundForPlayerBJ(Player(ui),gg_snd_LEVEL_UP)
            endif
        endif
        
        call RRRequestPlayer(REQUEST_UI_RESULT_UPDATE,Player(ui))
    endfunction
    
    private function CallBackXp takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer ui = tick.getExpired().data
        local FXResultInterface parent = FXResultInterface[ui]
        
        if parent.CurXP >= parent.XP then
            call ui:TICK.start(0.03125,true,function CallBackStat)
            if GetLocalPlayer() == Player(ui) then
                call StopSound(gg_snd_XP_GAIN,false,false)
            endif
            call StartSoundForPlayerBJ(Player(ui),gg_snd_XP_GAIN)
        endif
        set parent.CurXP = IMinBJ(parent.XP,parent.CurXP+1000)
        
        call RRRequestPlayer(REQUEST_UI_RESULT_UPDATE,Player(ui))
    endfunction
    private function CallBackXpBonus takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer ui = tick.getExpired().data
        local FXResultInterface parent = FXResultInterface[ui]
        
        if parent.CurXPBonus >= parent.XPBonus then
            call ui:TICK.start(0.03125,true,function CallBackXp)
            if GetLocalPlayer() == Player(ui) then
                call StopSound(gg_snd_XP_GAIN,false,false)
            endif
            call StartSoundForPlayerBJ(Player(ui),gg_snd_XP_GAIN)
        endif
        set parent.CurXPBonus = IMinBJ(parent.XPBonus,parent.CurXPBonus+1000)
        
        call RRRequestPlayer(REQUEST_UI_RESULT_UPDATE,Player(ui))
    endfunction
    private function CallBackXpBase takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer ui = tick.getExpired().data
        local FXResultInterface parent = FXResultInterface[ui]
        
        if parent.CurXPBase >= parent.XPBase then
            call ui:TICK.start(0.03125,true,function CallBackXpBonus)
            call StartSoundForPlayerBJ(Player(ui),gg_snd_XP_GAIN)
        endif
        set parent.CurXPBase = IMinBJ(parent.XPBase,parent.CurXPBase+1000)
        
        call RRRequestPlayer(REQUEST_UI_RESULT_UPDATE,Player(ui))
    endfunction
    
    private function onOpening takes nothing returns nothing
        local GameResponse res = RRGetResponse()
        local player p = res.Player
        local integer ui = GetPlayerId(p)
        local FXResultInterface parent = FXResultInterface[ui]

scope FXResultXPCalc initializer main

    private function onGamePlayerResulted takes nothing returns nothing
        local GameResponse res = RRGetResponse()
        local player p = res.Player
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
        local FXResultInterface resultUI = FXResultInterface[id]
        local boolean isVictory = res.Id == FXGameResult.Victory
        local integer axp = 0
        
        // 스피드런 모드 (시간 기록)
        if MODE_CURRENT == MODE_SPEEDRUN and isVictory then
            set FXRD_CLEAR_TIME[id] = playtime.current
            call statusBoard.finishWave( p )
        endif
        //협동 모드 (추가 경험치 계산)
        if MODE_CURRENT == MODE_TEAM and isVictory then
            set USER_XP_BONUS[id] = USER_XP_BONUS[id] + R2I(50 * CountInGameUser() / 4)
        endif
        
        set resultUI.Result = res.Id
        set resultUI.PlayerFaction = FXGetPlayerCurrentFaction(p)
        // '경험치 부여 전' 상태 반영
        set resultUI.CurPlayerMastered = FXIsPlayerCurrentFactionMastered(p)
        set resultUI.CurPlayerLevel = FXGetPlayerLevel(p)
        set resultUI.CurPlayerXP = FXGetPlayerXp(p)
        
        set resultUI.CurXPBase = 0
        set resultUI.CurXPBonus = 0
        set resultUI.CurXP = 0
        
        if isVictory then
            set resultUI.XPBase = LEVEL_XP[LEVEL_CURRENT]
            set resultUI.XPBonus = resultUI.XPBase * USER_XP_BONUS[id] / 100
            set resultUI.XP = resultUI.XPBase + resultUI.XPBonus
            set axp = resultUI.XP
        else
            //경험치 보너스 손실
            set USER_XP_BONUS[id] = 0
            //진행한 라운드 비례 50% 보상
            set axp = LEVEL_WAVE[LEVEL_CURRENT] / 2
            debug call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "임계 라운드 = "+I2S(axp))
            set axp = IMaxBJ(0,GetUserWave(p) - axp) * 50 / axp
            debug call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "경험치 보너스 비율 = "+I2S(axp))
            set axp = LEVEL_XP[LEVEL_CURRENT] * axp / 100
            
            set resultUI.XPBase = axp
            set resultUI.XPBonus = 0
            set resultUI.XP = axp
        endif
        //경험치 부여
        debug call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "획득한 경험치 = "+I2S(axp))
        call FXAddPlayerXp( p, axp )
        debug call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "[경험치 부여 완료]")
        set USER_IS_MASTER[id] = FXIsPlayerCurrentFactionMastered(p)
        // 부여 결과 반영
        set resultUI.PlayerMastered = FXIsPlayerCurrentFactionMastered(p)
        if resultUI.PlayerMastered != resultUI.CurPlayerMastered then
            set resultUI.PlayerLevel = FX_FACTION_MAX_LEVEL
            set resultUI.PlayerXP = 0
        else
            set resultUI.PlayerLevel = FXGetPlayerLevel(p)
            set resultUI.PlayerXP = FXGetPlayerXp(p)
        endif
        //플레이타임 누적
        set FXRD_CLEAR_TIME[id] = playtime.current
        set DATA_PLAYTIME[id] = DATA_PLAYTIME[id] + R2I(FXRD_CLEAR_TIME[id]/60)
        
        set p = null
    endfunction

    private function main takes nothing returns nothing
        call RRRegisterResponseEvent(RESPONSE_GAME_PLAYER_RESULT, function onGamePlayerResulted)
    endfunction
    
endscope

scope FXGameResultScope initializer main
    private function onGameResultRequested takes nothing returns nothing
        local GameRequest req = RRGetRequest()
        local player p = RRGetRequestPlayer()
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
        local boolean isProperPlayer = ( p != null )
        local integer result = 0
        // 유효성 검사
        if GetPlayerSlotState(p) == PLAYER_SLOT_STATE_LEFT then
            set isProperPlayer = false
        endif
        /*if GetPlayerController(p) != MAP_CONTROL_USER then /* CPU 유저 커트 */
            return
        endif*/
        if not isProperPlayer then
            debug call BJDebugMsg("[오류, 잘못된 요청] 존재하지 않는 플레이어에 대한 '"+req.Tag+"' 요청됨!")
            return
        endif
        if FXGameResult[id].Resulted then
            debug call BJDebugMsg("[경고, 요청 중복됨] 플레이어 "+I2S(id+1)+" 에 대한 승패처리가 또 요청되었음!")
            return
        endif
        set FXGameResult[id].Resulted = true
        // 결과 분석
        if req == REQUEST_GAME_PLAYER_VICTORY then
            set result = FXGameResult.Victory
        endif
        if req == REQUEST_GAME_PLAYER_DEFEAT then
            set result = FXGameResult.Defeat
        endif
        // 브로드캐스트
        call RRResponsePlayerId(RESPONSE_GAME_PLAYER_RESULT,p,result)
        set p = null
    endfunction

library FXFortnia requires FXLifeSpan
/*
    사용법
        local FX_FORTNIA myFortnia = FXRD_FXFortniaCreate( rect )
        call FXRD_FXFortniaDestroy( myFortnia )
    설명
*/
    globals
        //모델 - 실제 효과 모델
        private constant integer AIMP = 'o01W'
        //모델 - 효과 범위 표시기 모델
        private constant integer AWAR = 'o01V'
    endglobals
    
    globals
        private boolean array OEXI
        private unit array UWAR
        private unit array UDUM
        private real array ADSX
        private real array ADSY
        private rect array AREC
        private integer array AIDX
    endglobals
    
    struct FX_FORTNIA extends array
    endstruct
    
    private function EnumSplash takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick self
        if IsUnitAlly(GetEnumUnit(),FX_PLAYER_ENEMY) then
            return
        endif
        if not IsUnitType(GetEnumUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_TAUREN) then
            return
        endif
        set self = tick.getExpired()
        if IsUnitInRangeXY(GetEnumUnit(),ADSX[self],ADSY[self],500) then
            return
        endif
        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Weapons\\LichMissile\\LichMissile.mdl", GetEnumUnit(), "chest"))
        call EVDebuffStunServant.apply( GetEnumUnit(), 10.0 )
    endfunction
    
    private function OnExpire takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick self = tick.getExpired()
        if AIDX[self] == 0 then
            set ADSX[self] = GetRandomReal(GetRectMinX(AREC[self])+500,GetRectMaxX(AREC[self])-500)
            set ADSY[self] = GetRandomReal(GetRectMinY(AREC[self])+500,GetRectMaxY(AREC[self])-500)
            set UWAR[self] = CreateUnit(FX_PLAYER_DUMMY, AWAR, ADSX[self], ADSY[self], 270 )
            call FXRD_FXLifeSpanCommon( UWAR[self], 15.0 )
            set AIDX[self] = 1
            call self.start( 10.0, false, function OnExpire )
            return
        endif
        if AIDX[self] < 7 then
            if AIDX[self] == 1 then
                set UDUM[self] =CreateUnit(FX_PLAYER_DUMMY,AIMP,GetRectCenterX(AREC[self]), GetRectCenterY(AREC[self]),270)
                call SetUnitAnimation(UDUM[self],"birth")
                call FXRD_FXLifeSpanCommon( UDUM[self], 5.0 )
                call SetUnitVertexColor(UDUM[self],255,255,255,128)
            endif
            call splash.rect( splash.ANY, null, AREC[self], function EnumSplash )
            set AIDX[self] = AIDX[self] + 1
            call self.start( 1.0, false, function OnExpire )
            return
        endif
        set AIDX[self] = 0
        call self.start( 5.0, false, function OnExpire )
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXFortniaCreate takes rect r returns FX_FORTNIA
        local tick self = tick.create(0)
        set OEXI[self] = true
        set AREC[self] = r
        set AIDX[self] = 0
        call self.start( 5.0, false, function OnExpire )
        return self
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXFortniaDestroy takes FX_FORTNIA src returns nothing
        local tick self = src
        if not OEXI[self] then
            call DisplayTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(),0,0,"치명적인 오류 발생 : 존재하지 않는 FX_FORTNIA FXRD 오브젝트 파괴를 시도했습니다.")
            return
        endif
        call KillUnit( UWAR[self] )
        set UWAR[self] = null
        call KillUnit( UDUM[self] )
        set UDUM[self] = null
        set AREC[self] = null
        set OEXI[self] = false
        call self.destroy()
    endfunction
    
endlibrary

library FXBlackhole requires FXKnockback
/*
    사용법
        local FX_BLACKHOLE myBlackhole = FXRD_FXBlackholeCreate( minX, maxX, minY, maxY, speed )
        call FXRD_FXBlackholeDestroy( myBlackhole )

        private constant integer INMD = 'o006'
    endglobals
    
    globals
        private boolean array OEXI
        private unit array UDUM
        private unit array UWAR
        private real array MINX
        private real array MAXX
        private real array MINY
        private real array MAXY
        private real array DSTX
        private real array DSTY
        private real array ASPD
        private integer array ITER
    endglobals
    
    struct FX_BLACKHOLE extends array
    endstruct
    
    private function EnumSplash takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick self
        if IsUnitAlly(GetEnumUnit(),FX_PLAYER_ENEMY) then
            return
        endif
        if not IsUnitType(GetEnumUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_TAUREN) then
            return
        endif
        set self = tick.getExpired()

        local tick self = tick.getExpired()

            set x = DSTX[self]
            set y = DSTY[self]
            set DSTX[self] = GetRandomReal(MINX[self],MAXX[self])
            set DSTY[self] = GetRandomReal(MINY[self],MAXY[self])

            set x = GetUnitX(UDUM[self]) + Polar.X(ASPD[self],ang)

        call SetUnitY( UDUM[self], y )

        call SetUnitY( UWAR[self], y )
        set ITER[self] = ITER[self] - 1

        call FXRD_FXStasisField( x, y, 시전 시간, 존속 시간 )
    설명
        일정 범위 내 모든 '플레이어 유닛'들의 이동/공격을 정지시키는 정지장을 소환합니다.
*/
    globals
        //모델 - 정지장 모델
        private constant integer STMD = 'o004'
        //모델 - 시간 표시기 모델
        private constant integer INMD = 'o003'
        //애니메이션 시간 - 시간 표시기 애니메이션 시간
        private constant real INTS = 10.00
        //능력 - 정지장 오오라 능력
        private constant integer ABID = 'S004'
    endglobals

    globals
        private real array ADUR
        private unit array ADUM
    endglobals

    private function OnExpire takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick ATIK = tick.getExpired()
        call KillUnit( ADUM[ATIK] )
        set ADUM[ATIK] = null
        call ATIK.destroy()
    endfunction

    private function OnImpact takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick ATIK = tick.getExpired()
        local unit u = CreateUnit(Player(PLAYER_NEUTRAL_PASSIVE),STMD, GetUnitX(ADUM[ATIK]),GetUnitY(ADUM[ATIK]), 270 )
        call UnitApplyTimedLife(u,'BHwe',ADUR[ATIK])
        call SetUnitVertexColor(u,255,255,255,128)
        call SetUnitAnimation(u, "birth" )
        set u = null
        call ShowUnit( ADUM[ATIK], false )
        call ATIK.start( RMaxBJ(0.04,ADUR[ATIK]-3.50), false, function OnExpire )
    endfunction

    private function OnCastFinish takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick ATIK = tick.getExpired()
        call UnitAddAbility( ADUM[ATIK], ABID )
        call ATIK.start( 0.50, false, function OnImpact )
    endfunction

    function FXRD_FXStasisField takes real x, real y, real casdur, real dur returns nothing
        local tick ATIK = tick.create(0)
        set ADUR[ATIK] = dur
        set ADUM[ATIK] = CreateUnit( Player(11), INMD, x, y, 270 )
        call SetUnitTimeScale( ADUM[ATIK], INTS/casdur )
        call ATIK.start( RMaxBJ(0.04,casdur-0.50), false, function OnCastFinish )
    endfunction
endlibrary

library FXCharge requires FXKnockback, FXLifeSpan
/*
    사용법
        call FXRD_FXCharge( 타겟, x, y, 캐스트 시간 )
        call FXRD_FXChargeSource( 타겟, 캐스트 시간 )
    설명
        일정 범위 내 모든 '플레이어 유닛'을 밀칩니다.
*/
    globals
        private real array ADUR
        private unit array ADST
        private real array ADSX
        private real array ADSY
    endglobals
    
    private function Destroy takes tick ATIK returns nothing
        set ADST[ATIK] = null
        call ATIK.destroy()
    endfunction

    private function EnumSplash takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick self
        if IsUnitAlly(GetEnumUnit(),FX_PLAYER_ENEMY) then
            return
        endif
        if not IsUnitType(GetEnumUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_TAUREN) then
            return
        endif
        set self = tick.getExpired()
        call EVDebuffStunServant.apply( GetEnumUnit(), 3.00 )
        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Weapons\\LichMissile\\LichMissile.mdl", GetEnumUnit(), "chest"))
        call FXRD_FXKnockbackFromPos( GetEnumUnit(), ADSX[self], ADSY[self], 500, 250, 0.625 )
    endfunction
    
    private function OnImpact takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick ATIK = tick.getExpired()
        if ADST[ATIK] == null then
            call splash.range( splash.ANY, null, ADSX[ATIK], ADSY[ATIK], 500, function EnumSplash )
        else
            if not IsUnitDead(ADST[ATIK]) then
                set ADSX[ATIK] = GetUnitX(ADST[ATIK])
                set ADSY[ATIK] = GetUnitY(ADST[ATIK])
                call splash.range( splash.ANY, null, ADSX[ATIK], ADSY[ATIK], 500, function EnumSplash )
            endif
        endif
        call Destroy(ATIK)
    endfunction
    
    private function OnCastStart takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick ATIK = tick.getExpired()
        local unit u = null
        if ADST[ATIK] == null then
            set u = FXRD_FXAoeAlert(AOE_CIRCLE_NOLOOP,ADSX[ATIK],ADSY[ATIK],270,255,0,0,255,5)
            call SetUnitTimeScale(u,ADUR[ATIK]*0.1)
            call UnitApplyTimedLife(u, 'BHwe', ADUR[ATIK])
        else
            if IsUnitDead(ADST[ATIK]) then
                call Destroy(ATIK)
                return
            endif
            set ADSX[ATIK] = GetUnitX(ADST[ATIK])
            set ADSY[ATIK] = GetUnitY(ADST[ATIK])
            set u = FXRD_FXAoeAlert(AOE_CIRCLE_NOLOOP,ADSX[ATIK],ADSY[ATIK],270,255,0,0,255,5)
            call SetUnitTimeScale(u,ADUR[ATIK]*0.1)
            call FXRD_FXLifeSpanCommon( u, ADUR[ATIK] )
            call FXRD_FXBinderBindUnit( u, ADST[ATIK] )
            call DummyFollowUnit.cast( u, ADST[ATIK] )
        endif
        set u = null
        call ATIK.start( ADUR[ATIK], false, function OnImpact )
    endfunction

    function FXRD_FXCharge takes unit u, real x, real y, real casdur, real dur returns nothing
        local tick ATIK = tick.create(0)
        set ADST[ATIK] = u
        set ADSX[ATIK] = x
        set ADSY[ATIK] = y
        set ADUR[ATIK] = dur
        call ATIK.start( casdur, false, function OnCastStart )
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXChargeSource takes unit src, real casdur, real dur returns nothing
        call FXRD_FXCharge(src, GetUnitX(src), GetUnitY(src), casdur, dur )
    endfunction
endlibrary

library FXBomb requires FXDebuffShock, FXKnockback

        //모델 - 폭풍 모델

    endglobals
    
    globals
        private unit array UCAS
        private unit array UWAR
        private real array DSTX
        private real array DSTY
        private real array DRAD
    endglobals
    
    private function EnumSplash takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick self
        if IsUnitAlly(GetEnumUnit(),FX_PLAYER_ENEMY) then
            return
        endif
        if not IsUnitType(GetEnumUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_TAUREN) then

library FXBinder requires UnitIndexer, HandleUserData
/*
    사용법
        페엑랜디 연결 - (원본) 유닛과 (특정 유닛)의 목숨을 연결합니다
            call FXRD_FXBinderBindUnit( unit src, unit dst )
        페엑랜디 연결 - (원본) 유닛과 (특정 유닛)의 목숨 연결을 끊습니다
            call FXRD_FXBinderUnbindUnit( unit src, unit dst )
        페엑랜디 연결 - (원본) 유닛의 모든 연결을 끊습니다.
            call FXRD_FXBinderClearUnit( unit src )
    설명
        원본 유닛을 특정 유닛과 '연결'시킵니다.
        연결된 특정 유닛이 사망하면, 원본 유닛도 사망합니다.
*/
    globals
        private boolean array FX_EXISTS
        private unit array FX_SOURCE
        private trigger array FX_REMOVETRIG
        private triggeraction array FX_REMOVEACTION
        
        private trigger array FX_BINDTRIG
        private triggeraction array FX_BINDACTION
        private group array FX_BINDGRP
    endglobals
    
    private function Free takes integer self returns nothing
        call TriggerRemoveAction(FX_BINDTRIG[self], FX_BINDACTION[self])
        set FX_BINDACTION[self] = null
        call DestroyTrigger(FX_BINDTRIG[self])
        set FX_BINDTRIG[self] = null
        call GroupClear(FX_BINDGRP[self])
        call DestroyGroup(FX_BINDGRP[self])
        set FX_BINDGRP[self] = null
        call TriggerRemoveAction(FX_REMOVETRIG[self], FX_REMOVEACTION[self])
        set FX_REMOVEACTION[self] = null
        set FX_REMOVETRIG[self] = null
        set FX_SOURCE[self] = null
        set FX_EXISTS[self] = false
    endfunction
    
    private function OnRemove takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer self = GetTriggerIndex()
        call Free(self)
    endfunction
    
    private function OnBindedKilled takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer self = GetHandleUserData(GetTriggeringTrigger())
        if not IsUnitInGroup(GetTriggerUnit(),FX_BINDGRP[self]) then
            return
        endif
        call KillUnit(FX_SOURCE[self])
    endfunction
    
    private function Allocate takes integer self, unit src returns nothing
        set FX_EXISTS[self] = true
        set FX_SOURCE[self] = src
        set FX_REMOVETRIG[self] = GetUnitRemoveTrigger(src)
        set FX_REMOVEACTION[self] = TriggerAddAction(FX_REMOVETRIG[self], function OnRemove )
        set FX_BINDTRIG[self] = CreateTrigger()
        call SetHandleUserData(FX_BINDTRIG[self],self)
        set FX_BINDACTION[self] = TriggerAddAction(FX_BINDTRIG[self], function OnBindedKilled)
        set FX_BINDGRP[self] = CreateGroup()
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXBinderBindUnit takes unit src, unit dst returns nothing
        local integer self
        //유효성 검사 ( 소스, 바인딩 대상 )
        if GetUnitTypeId( src ) == 0 then
            return
        endif
        if GetUnitTypeId( dst ) == 0 then
            return
        endif
        set self = IndexUnit( src )
        if not FX_EXISTS[self] then
            call Allocate(self, src)
        endif
        if not IsUnitInGroup(dst,FX_BINDGRP[self]) then
            call GroupAddUnit(FX_BINDGRP[self],dst)
            call TriggerRegisterUnitEvent(FX_BINDTRIG[self],dst,EVENT_UNIT_DEATH)
        endif
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXBinderUnbindUnit takes unit src, unit dst returns nothing
        local integer self
        //유효성 검사 ( 소스, 바인딩 대상 )
        if GetUnitTypeId( src ) == 0 then
            return
        endif
        if GetUnitTypeId( dst ) == 0 then
            return
        endif
        set self = IndexUnit( src )
        if not FX_EXISTS[self] then
            return
        endif
        if IsUnitInGroup(dst,FX_BINDGRP[self]) then
            call GroupRemoveUnit(FX_BINDGRP[self],dst)
        endif
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXBinderClearUnit takes unit src returns nothing
        local integer self
        //유효성 검사 ( 소스, 바인딩 대상 )
        if GetUnitTypeId( src ) == 0 then
            return
        endif
        set self = IndexUnit( src )
        if not FX_EXISTS[self] then
            return
        endif
        call GroupClear(FX_BINDGRP[self])
    endfunction
endlibrary

library FXKnockback requires SafePos, FXImmuneKnockback
/*
    사용법
        call FXRD_FXKnockback( source, angle, distance, maxZ, duration )
        call FXRD_FXKnockbackTo( source, destX, destY, maxZ, duration )
        call FXRD_FXKnockbackFrom( source, originUnit, distance, maxZ, duration )
    설명
        대상 유닛을 넉백시킵니다. (기절 행동은 포함 안 됨)
*/
    globals
        //능력 - 넉백 중
        private constant integer ABID = 'A065'
        //버프 - 넉백 중
        private constant integer BFID = 'B002'
    endglobals
    
    globals
        private unit array USRC
        private real array XEND
        private real array YEND
        private real array ZHEI
        private real array PODX
        private real array PODY
        private real array PRVZ
        private real array SUMZ
        private integer array IMAX
        private integer array ICUR
    endglobals
    
    private function OnExpire takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick self = tick.getExpired()
        local real curZ
        local real dltZ
        set ICUR[self] = ICUR[self] + 1
        set curZ = ZHEI[self]*Sin(3.14*ICUR[self]/IMAX[self])
        set dltZ = curZ - PRVZ[self]
        set SUMZ[self] = SUMZ[self] + dltZ
        set PRVZ[self] = curZ
        call SetUnitX( USRC[self], GetUnitX( USRC[self] ) + PODX[self] )
        call SetUnitY( USRC[self], GetUnitY( USRC[self] ) + PODY[self] )
        call SetUnitFlyHeight( USRC[self], GetUnitFlyHeight(USRC[self]) + dltZ , 0.00 )
        if ICUR[self] < IMAX[self] then
            return
        endif
        if not IsUnitDead(USRC[self]) then
            call UnitRemoveAbility( USRC[self], ABID )
            call UnitRemoveAbility( USRC[self], BFID )
            call SetUnitFlyHeight( USRC[self], GetUnitFlyHeight(USRC[self]) - SUMZ[self] , 0.00 )
        endif
        set USRC[self] = null
        call self.destroy()
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXKnockbackTo takes unit src, real tx, real ty, real mz, real dur returns nothing
        local tick self
        local real dist
        local real direct
        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(src,ABID) > 0 then
            return
        endif
        if FXRD_FXIsImmuneKnockback(src) then
            return
        endif
        call UnitAddAbility(src,ABID)
        set self = tick.create(0)
        set PRVZ[self] = 0
        set SUMZ[self] = 0
        set USRC[self] = src
        call SetSafeXY( tx, ty )
        set XEND[self] = GetSafeX()
        set YEND[self] = GetSafeY()
        set ZHEI[self] = mz
        set dist = Distance.WBP( src, XEND[self], YEND[self] )
        set direct = Angle.WBP( src, XEND[self], YEND[self] )
        set IMAX[self] = IMaxBJ(1,R2I(dur*32))
        set PODX[self] = Polar.X( dist/IMAX[self], direct )
        set PODY[self] = Polar.Y( dist/IMAX[self], direct )
        set ICUR[self] = 0
        call self.start( 0.03125, true, function OnExpire )
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXKnockback takes unit src, real dir, real dist, real mz, real dur returns nothing
        local real x = GetUnitX(src) + Polar.X( dist, dir )
        local real y = GetUnitY(src) + Polar.Y( dist, dir )
        call FXRD_FXKnockbackTo( src, x, y, mz, dur )
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXKnockbackFrom takes unit src, unit ori, real dist, real mz, real dur returns nothing
        local real dir = Angle.WBW( ori, src )
        call FXRD_FXKnockback( src, dir, dist, mz, dur )
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXKnockbackFromPos takes unit src, real ox, real oy, real dist, real mz, real dur returns nothing
        local real dir = Angle.PBW( ox, oy, src )
        call FXRD_FXKnockback( src, dir, dist, mz, dur )
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXKnockbackFromTo takes unit src, unit ori, real dist, real mz, real dur returns nothing
        local real dir = Angle.WBW( ori, src )
        set dist = dist - Distance.WBW( ori, src )
        call FXRD_FXKnockback( src, dir, dist, mz, dur )
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXKnockbackFromToPos takes unit src, real ox, real oy, real dist, real mz, real dur returns nothing
        local real dir = Angle.PBW( ox,oy, src )
        set dist = dist - Distance.PBW( ox,oy, src )
        call FXRD_FXKnockback( src, dir, dist, mz, dur )
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXKnockbackInverse takes unit src, unit ori, real dist, real mz, real dur returns nothing
        local real dir = Angle.WBW( ori, src ) - 180
        call FXRD_FXKnockback( src, dir, dist, mz, dur )
    endfunction
endlibrary

library FXImmuneStun requires UnitIndexer
/*
    사용법
        페엑랜디 스턴 - (유닛)을 항상 기절에 대한 (면역/약함) 상태로 만듭니다.
        call FXRD_FXImmuneStun( source, flag )
        페엑랜디 스턴 - (유닛)을 즉시 기절에 대한 (면역/약함) 상태로 만듭니다.
        call FXRD_FXImmuneStunForced( source, flag )
        페엑랜디 스턴 - (유닛)을 (일정 시간) 동안 면역 상태로 만듭니다.
        call FXRD_FXImmuneStunTimed( source, duration )
    설명
        대상 유닛을 'FXRD - 기절 면역' 상태로 만듭니다.
*/
    globals
        //능력 - 기절 면역
        private constant integer ID_IMMUNE = 'A09B'
        private constant integer BUFF_IMMUNE = 'B00F'
    endglobals
    
    globals
        private boolean array FX_EXISTS
        private unit array FX_SOURCE
        private trigger array FX_REMOVETRIG
        private triggeraction array FX_REMOVEACTION
        private boolean array FX_ALWAYS
        private boolean array FX_TIMMED
        private tick array FX_TICK
    endglobals
    
    private function Free takes integer self returns nothing
        call FX_TICK[self].destroy()
        call TriggerRemoveAction(FX_REMOVETRIG[self], FX_REMOVEACTION[self])
        set FX_REMOVEACTION[self] = null
        set FX_REMOVETRIG[self] = null
        set FX_SOURCE[self] = null
        set FX_TIMMED[self] = false
        set FX_ALWAYS[self] = false
        set FX_EXISTS[self] = false
    endfunction
    
    private function OnRemove takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer self = GetTriggerIndex()
        call Free(self)
    endfunction
    
    private function Allocate takes integer self, unit src returns nothing
        set FX_EXISTS[self] = true
        set FX_ALWAYS[self] = false
        set FX_TIMMED[self] = false
        set FX_SOURCE[self] = src
        set FX_REMOVETRIG[self] = GetUnitRemoveTrigger(src)
        set FX_REMOVEACTION[self] = TriggerAddAction(FX_REMOVETRIG[self], function OnRemove )
        set FX_TICK[self] = tick.create(self)
    endfunction
    
    private function OnExpire takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer self = tick.getExpired().data
        set FX_TIMMED[self] = false
        if FX_ALWAYS[self] then
            return
        endif
        call UnitRemoveAbility(FX_SOURCE[self], ID_IMMUNE)
        call UnitRemoveAbility(FX_SOURCE[self], BUFF_IMMUNE)
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXImmuneStun takes unit src, boolean flag returns nothing
        local integer self
        if GetUnitTypeId( src ) == 0 then
            return
        endif
        set self = IndexUnit( src )
        if not FX_EXISTS[self] then
            call Allocate(self, src)
        endif
        set FX_ALWAYS[self] = flag
        //
        if flag then
            if GetUnitAbilityLevel(src, ID_IMMUNE) == 0 then
                call UnitAddAbility(src, ID_IMMUNE)
            endif
            return
        endif
        //
        if not FX_TIMMED[self] then
            call UnitRemoveAbility(src, ID_IMMUNE)
            call UnitRemoveAbility(src, BUFF_IMMUNE)
        endif
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXImmuneStunForced takes unit src, boolean flag returns nothing
        local integer self
        if GetUnitTypeId( src ) == 0 then
            return
        endif
        set self = IndexUnit( src )
        if not FX_EXISTS[self] then
            call Allocate(self, src)
        endif
        set FX_ALWAYS[self] = flag
        //Forcing over tick control
        if FX_TIMMED[self] then
            set FX_TIMMED[self] = false
            call FX_TICK[self].pause()
        endif
        //
        if flag then
            if GetUnitAbilityLevel(src, ID_IMMUNE) == 0 then
                call UnitAddAbility(src, ID_IMMUNE)
            endif
            return
        endif
        //
        call UnitRemoveAbility(src, ID_IMMUNE)
        call UnitRemoveAbility(src, BUFF_IMMUNE)
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXImmuneStunTimed takes unit src, real delay returns nothing
        local integer self
        if GetUnitTypeId( src ) == 0 then
            return
        endif
        set self = IndexUnit( src )
        if not FX_EXISTS[self] then
            call Allocate(self, src)
        endif
        //
        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(src, ID_IMMUNE) == 0 then
            call UnitAddAbility(src, ID_IMMUNE)
        endif
        //
        if FX_TIMMED[self] then
            if FX_TICK[self].remaining >= delay then
                return
            endif
        endif
        set FX_TIMMED[self] = true
        call FX_TICK[self].start( delay, false, function OnExpire )
    endfunction
    
endlibrary

library FXImmuneKnockback requires UnitIndexer
/*
    사용법

        call FXRD_FXImmuneKnockback( source, flag )

        set FX_TIMMED[self] = false
        call FX_TICK[self].pause()
        //
        call DestroyEffect(FX_EFFECT[self])
        set FX_EFFECT[self] = null
        call UnitRemoveAbility(src, ID_ABILITY)
        call UnitRemoveAbility(src, ID_DEBUFF)
    endfunction
    
    function FXRD_FXPauseLifeEx takes unit src, real delay, string efpth, string efpnt returns nothing
        local integer self
        if GetUnitTypeId( src ) == 0 then
            return
        endif
        set self = IndexUnit( src )
        if not FX_EXISTS[self] then
            call Allocate(self, src)
        endif
        //
        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(src, ID_ABILITY) == 0 then
            call UnitAddAbility(src, ID_ABILITY)
        endif
        //
        if FX_TIMMED[self] then
            if FX_TICK[self].remaining >= delay then
                return
            endif
        endif
        set FX_TIMMED[self] = true
        call DestroyEffect(FX_EFFECT[self])
        set FX_EFFECT[self] = AddSpecialEffectTarget(efpth,src,efpnt)
        call FX_TICK[self].start( delay, false, function OnExpire )
    endfunction
    function FXRD_FXPauseLife takes unit src, real delay returns nothing
        call FXRD_FXPauseLifeEx( src, delay, PATH_EFFECT, POINT_EFFECT )
    endfunction
    
endlibrary

        local player p = GetOwningPlayer(src)

        local unit u
        if lev < 4 then
            call DisplayTextToPlayer( p, 0.00, 0.00, "조합으로 "+trimmer.get( GetUnitTypeId(src) ) + " 획득하려 했으나..." )

        call DestroyEffect( AddSpecialEffect("FX\\Kiara\\Burst.mdl",x,y) )
        call bountyTag.custom( p, x, y, "|c00FF0000『난수 간섭』|r" )

    private tick durationTimer
    private boolean running
    static method apply takes unit src, unit cas, real dur, integer cnt returns nothing
        local thistype this = IndexUnit(src)
        if this == 0 then
            return
        endif
        if not .exist then
            set .exist = true
            set .source = src
            set .caster = cas
            set .duration = dur
            set .count = cnt
            set .running = false
            set .durationTimer = tick.create(this)
            set .rmTrig = GetUnitRemoveTrigger( src )
            set .rmAct = TriggerAddAction(.rmTrig, function thistype.onSourceRemove)
        endif
        if .running then
            if .count < 0 then
                return
            endif
            if dur*cnt < .count*.duration then
                return
            endif
            set .count = cnt
            set .duration = dur
        else
            set .running = true
            set .count = cnt
            set .duration = dur
            call .onBuffStart()
            call .durationTimer.start( .duration, false, function thistype.onExpire )
        endif
        call .onBuffRefresh()
    endmethod
    
    private static method onExpire takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired().data
        if IsUnitDead(.source) then
            set .running = false
            call .onBuffEnd()
            return
        endif
        if .count > 0 then
            set .count = .count - 1
        endif
        call .onBuffEffect()
        if .count == 0 then
            set .running = false
            call .onBuffEnd()
            return
        endif
        call .durationTimer.start( .duration, false, function thistype.onExpire )
    endmethod

        call TriggerRemoveAction(.rmTrig, .rmAct)
        set .rmAct = null
        set .rmTrig = null
        if .running then

        endif
        call .durationTimer.destroy()
        set .source = null
        set .caster = null

    private static method SummonEnd takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick t = tick.getExpired()
        if not IsUnitDead(MIR_U[t]) then

                call KillUnit(CreateUnit(Player(PLAYER_NEUTRAL_PASSIVE),'o02I',GetUnitX(MIR_U[t]), GetUnitY(MIR_U[t]),GetRandomReal(0.0,360.0)))
                call splash.range( splash.ENEMY, MIR_S[t], GetUnitX(MIR_U[t]), GetUnitY(MIR_U[t]), 700.0, function thistype.enumDealt )
            endif
            call servant.kill(MIR_U[t],false)
        endif
        set MIR_S[t] = null
        set MIR_U[t] = null
        set MIR_P[t] = null
        call t.destroy()
    endmethod
    private static method SummonMirror takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick t = tick.getExpired()
        set MIR_U[t] = CreateUnit(MIR_P[t], 'h010', MIR_X[t], MIR_Y[t], MIR_F[t])
        //call SetUnitPropWindow(MIR_U[t],0.0)
        call SetUnitVertexColor(MIR_U[t],255,255,255,224)
        call servant.add( MIR_P[t],MIR_U[t], servant.QUIET )
        
        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(MIR_S[t],'A02W') > 0 then
            call UnitAddAbility(MIR_U[t], 'A02W' )
            call EVDamageManager.addBonus( MIR_U[t], 100 )
        endif
        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(MIR_S[t],'A0GO') > 0 then
            call SetUnitVertexColor(MIR_U[t],32,32,32,224)
            call UnitAddAbility(MIR_U[t],'A0GO')
            call UnitAddAbility(MIR_U[t],'A0GN')
            call EVDamageManager.addBonus( MIR_U[t], 50 )
        endif
        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(MIR_S[t],'A0GP') > 0 then
            call SetUnitVertexColor(MIR_U[t],32,32,32,224)
            call UnitAddAbility(MIR_U[t],'A0GP')
            call UnitAddAbility(MIR_U[t],'A0GR')
            call EVDamageManager.addBonus( MIR_U[t], 400 )
        endif
        
        call t.start(5.0,false,function thistype.SummonEnd)
    endmethod
        
    private static method SummonLoops takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        local tick t
        if .count > 0 and not IsUnitDead(.caster) then
            set t = tick.create(0)
            set MIR_S[t] = .caster
            set MIR_X[t] = GetUnitX(.caster) + GetRandomReal(-256.0,256.0)
            set MIR_Y[t] = GetUnitY(.caster) + GetRandomReal(-256.0,256.0)
            set MIR_F[t] = GetUnitFacing(.caster)
            set MIR_P[t] = GetOwningPlayer(.caster)
            call t.start(0.1,false,function thistype.SummonMirror)
        endif
        set .count = .count - 1
        if .count > 0 then
            return
        endif
        set .caster = null
        call .main.destroy()
    endmethod
    static method apply takes unit src, integer amt returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.create(0)
        set .caster = src
        set .count = amt
        set .main = this
        call .main.start( 0.1, true, function thistype.SummonLoops )
    endmethod

    // 사용자 정의 멤버

    private static method enumGetTarget takes nothing returns nothing
        if GetEnumUnit() == EXCLUDE then
            return
        endif
        if GetRandomInt( 0, CNT ) == 0 then
            set DEST = GetEnumUnit()
        endif
        set CNT = CNT + 1
    endmethod
    private static method onFire takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        set .count = .count - 1
        set DEST = null
        set EXCLUDE = .LastUnit
        set CNT = 0
        call splash.range( splash.ENEMY, .caster, .LastX, .LastY, 400.0, function thistype.enumGetTarget )
        set .LastUnit = DEST
        set EXCLUDE = null
        set DEST = null
        if .LastUnit != null then
            set .LastX = GetUnitX(.LastUnit)
            set .LastY = GetUnitY(.LastUnit)
            call SetUnitState( .caster, UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetUnitState( .caster, UNIT_STATE_MANA ) + 2.0 )

            set .caster = null
            set .LastUnit = null
            call .main.destroy()
            return
        endif
    endmethod

        set .caster = src
        set .LastX = GetUnitX(dst)

        call enemy.dealLogicEx( src, dst, EVDamageManager.getFinalDamage( src ), true, true, WEAPON_TYPE_METAL_HEAVY_STAB, 1 )
    endmethod

        local thistype this = tick.getExpired().data

        endif
        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(.source,'A0FH') < 3 then
            return
        endif
        if IsUnitDead( .MarkedTarget ) then
            set .MarkedTarget = null
            return
        endif
        if IsUnitInRangeXY(.MarkedTarget,GetUnitX(.source),GetUnitY(.source),GetUnitAcquireRange(.source)-200.0) then
            return
        endif
        call TestCM(.source,.MarkedTarget)
        set .MarkedTarget = null
    endmethod

        set .MarkedTarget = null
        set .MarkTick = tick.create(this)
        call .MarkTick.start( 1.0, true, function thistype.enumFunction )

    //! runtextmacro 어빌리티_이벤트_어빌리티_잃음()
        set .MarkedTarget = null

struct CMHeroineXCosmos extends array
    private tick main
    private unit caster
    private unit target
    private real damage
    private integer stage
    private static method onFinal takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        set .caster = null
        set .target = null
        call .main.destroy()
    endmethod
    private static method enumDealt takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Weapons\\FarseerMissile\\FarseerMissile.mdl",GetEnumUnit(),"chest"))
        if not IsUnitType(GetEnumUnit(),UNIT_TYPE_GIANT) then
            call FXRD_FXDebuffShock( GetEnumUnit(), 5.00 )
        endif
        call enemy.dealLogic( .caster, GetEnumUnit(), .damage, WEAPON_TYPE_METAL_HEAVY_BASH, 1 )
    endmethod
    private static method onFire takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        local real x = GetUnitX(.caster)
        local real y = GetUnitY(.caster)
        call .main.start( 0.20, false, function thistype.onFinal )
        if IsUnitDead(.caster) then
            return
        endif
        if IsUnitAlive(.target) then
            set x = GetUnitX(.target)
            set y = GetUnitY(.target)
        endif
        call SetSoundPosition(gg_snd_Puicell_4,x,y,300.00)
        call StartSound(gg_snd_Puicell_4)
        call SetSoundPosition(gg_snd_Puicell_5,x,y,300.00)
        call StartSound(gg_snd_Puicell_5)
        call KillUnit(CreateUnit(Player(PLAYER_NEUTRAL_PASSIVE),'o01Z',x,y,270.00))
        call splash.range( splash.ENEMY, .caster, x,y, 1000.0, function thistype.enumDealt )
    endmethod
    private static method onCharge takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        if IsUnitDead(.caster) then
            call .main.start( 0.20, false, function thistype.onFinal )
            return
        endif
        set .stage = .stage + 1
        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("FX Power Charge\\FX Power Charge Blue.mdl",.caster,"hand left"))
        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("FX Power Charge\\FX Power Charge Blue.mdl",.caster,"hand right"))
        if .stage == 15 then
            call .main.start( 0.50, false, function thistype.onFire )
        endif
    endmethod
    static method cast takes unit src, real dmg, unit dst returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.create(0)
        set .main = this
        set .caster = src
        set .target = dst
        set .damage = dmg
        set .stage = 0
        call .main.start( 0.10, true, function thistype.onCharge )
    endmethod
endstruct

        set .oy = GetUnitY(dst)

//! runtextmacro 어빌리티_선언_개시("MedusaBHold")
    // TODO : 어빌리티의 종류를 선언합니다.
    //! runtextmacro 어빌리티_종류_패시브_쿨타임_일정()
    // 사용자 정의 멤버
    private static unit DEST = null
    private static real LIFE = 0.0
    private static integer CNT = 0
    private static method enumGetTarget takes nothing returns nothing
        local real life
        if IsUnitType(GetEnumUnit(),UNIT_TYPE_GIANT) then
            return
        endif
        set life = GetEnumUnit():Life + GetEnumUnit():Mana
        if life < LIFE then
            return
        endif
        if life > LIFE then
            set CNT = 0
            set LIFE = life
        endif
        if GetRandomInt( 0, CNT ) == 0 then
            set DEST = GetEnumUnit()
        endif
        set CNT = CNT + 1
    endmethod
    private tick MarkTick
    private boolean MarkHolding
    private unit MarkedTarget
    private unit MarkDummy
    private effect MarkEffect
    private static method HoldCallBack takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired().data
        if .MarkedTarget:IsDead then
            call DestroyEffect(.MarkEffect)
            set .MarkEffect = null
            set .MarkedTarget = null
            call SetUnitVertexColor(.MarkDummy,128,128,128,0)
            set .MarkHolding = false
            return
        endif
    endmethod
    // TODO : 어빌리티의 종류에 대응되는 각 어빌리티 이벤트를 작성합니다.
    //! runtextmacro 어빌리티_이벤트_어빌리티_습득()

        set .MarkedTarget = null
        set .MarkDummy = CreateUnit(FX_PLAYER_DUMMY,'o02N',.source:PosX,source:PosY,source:Facing)
        call SetUnitVertexColor(.MarkDummy,128,128,128,0)
        set .MarkTick = tick.create(this)

        set .MarkDummy = null
        set .MarkedTarget = null

    //! runtextmacro 어빌리티_이벤트_어빌리티_효과_시작()
        local real tx
        local real ty
        if .MarkHolding then
            return
        endif
        set DEST = null
        set CNT = 0
        set LIFE = 0.0
        call splash.range( splash.ENEMY, .source, GetUnitX(.source), GetUnitY(.source), GetUnitAcquireRange(.source), function thistype.enumGetTarget )
        if DEST == null then
            return
        endif
        set .MarkedTarget = DEST
        set .MarkHolding = true
        set tx = .MarkedTarget:PosX - Polar.X(100.0,Angle.WBW(.source,.MarkedTarget))
        set ty = .MarkedTarget:PosY - Polar.Y(100.0,Angle.WBW(.source,.MarkedTarget))
        call SetUnitX(.MarkDummy,tx)
        call SetUnitY(.MarkDummy,ty)

        call SetUnitVertexColor(.MarkDummy,128,128,128,128)
        call SetUnitAnimation(.MarkDummy,"spell")
        set .MarkEffect = AddSpecialEffectTarget("FXRD\\FX\\BossIndicator\\BossIndicator.mdl",.MarkedTarget,"origin")
        call FXRD_FXDebuffShock( .MarkedTarget, 3600.0 )
        call FXRD_FXShieldBreak( .MarkedTarget, 3600.0 )
        call FXRD_FXPauseShield( .MarkedTarget, 3600.0 )
        call FXRD_FXPauseLife( .MarkedTarget, 3600.0 )

struct FXJewlet extends array
    private tick main
    private unit caster
    private unit myDummy
    private real damage
    private integer count
    private group myG
    private static method enumDealt takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        if IsUnitInGroup(GetEnumUnit(), .myG) then
            return
        endif
        call GroupAddUnit(.myG, GetEnumUnit())
        call EVDebuffSlow.apply( GetEnumUnit(), 3.00 )
        if IsUnitType(GetEnumUnit(),UNIT_TYPE_GIANT) then
            call enemy.dealLogicEx( .caster, GetEnumUnit(), .damage*0.5, true, true, WEAPON_TYPE_METAL_HEAVY_BASH, 0 )
        else
            call enemy.dealLogicEx( .caster, GetEnumUnit(), .damage, true, true, WEAPON_TYPE_METAL_HEAVY_BASH, 0 )
        endif
    endmethod
    private static method onFire takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        if IsUnitType(.caster, UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) or .count >= 10 then
            call KillUnit(.myDummy)
            set .myDummy = null
            call GroupClear( .myG )
            call DestroyGroup( .myG )
            set .myG = null
            set .caster = null
            call .main.destroy()
            return
        endif
        set .count = .count + 1
        call splash.range( splash.ENEMY, .caster, GetUnitX(.myDummy), GetUnitY(.myDummy), 500, function thistype.enumDealt )
    endmethod
    static method cast takes unit src, real tx, real ty, real dmg returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.create(0)
        local real ang = Angle.WBP(src,tx,ty)
        set .caster = src
        set .damage = dmg
        set .count = 0
        set .myG = CreateGroup()
        set .main = this
        set .myDummy = CreateUnit( Player(15), 'o028', GetUnitX(src)+Polar.X(200,ang),GetUnitY(src)+Polar.Y(200,ang), ang )
        call SetUnitAnimation(.myDummy, "birth")
        call DummyKnockback.cast( .myDummy, GetUnitAcquireRange(src)+100, ang, 0, 0.50 )
        call .main.start( 0.05, true, function thistype.onFire )
    endmethod
endstruct

struct CMLaserSingle extends array

    private unit caster
    private unit target
    private unit dummy
    private real damage
    private real ox
    private real oy
    private integer myCombo
    private static method onFinal takes nothing returns nothing

        set .target = null
        set .dummy = null
        call .mainFlow.destroy()
    endmethod
    private static method onFireStart takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()

            call .mainFlow.start( 0.40, false, function thistype.onFinal )
            return

        set .myCombo = .myCombo - 1

            call DummyLightningChaser.cast( "CLPB", 1, 1, 1, .dummy, 0, 0, 0, .target, 0, 0, 60, 0.30)
            call enemy.dealLogic( .caster, .target, .damage, WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS, 1 )
        endif
    endmethod
    static method cast takes unit src, unit dst, real dmg, integer combo, unit dum returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.create(0)
        set .caster = src
        set .target = dst
        set .damage = dmg
        set .myCombo = combo
        set .dummy = dum
        set .mainFlow = this
        call .mainFlow.start( 0.20, true, function thistype.onFireStart )

struct CMLaser extends array
    //
    private static unit DEST = null
    private static integer CNT = 0
    private static method enumGetTarget takes nothing returns nothing
        if IsUnitType(GetEnumUnit(),UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) then
            return
        endif
        if GetRandomInt( 0, CNT ) == 0 then
            set DEST = GetEnumUnit()
        endif
        set CNT = CNT + 1
    endmethod
    //
    static method cast takes unit src, unit pri, real dmg, integer combo, unit dum returns nothing
        local unit dst = pri
        if IsUnitType( pri,UNIT_TYPE_UNDEAD ) then
            set DEST = null
            set CNT = 0
            call splash.range( splash.ENEMY, src, GetUnitX(src), GetUnitY(src), GetUnitAcquireRange(src)+100, function thistype.enumGetTarget )
            set dst = DEST
            set DEST = null
        else
            set combo = 1
        endif
        call CMLaserSingle.cast( src, dst, dmg, combo, dum )
        set dst = null
    endmethod
endstruct

struct CMCannon extends array
    //
    private static unit DEST = null
    private static integer CNT = 0
    private static method enumGetTarget takes nothing returns nothing
        if GetRandomInt( 0, CNT ) == 0 then
            set DEST = GetEnumUnit()
        endif
        set CNT = CNT + 1
    endmethod
    private static method GetRandomEnemy takes unit src, real x, real y, real r returns unit
        set DEST = null
        set CNT = 0
        call splash.range( splash.ENEMY, src, x, y, r, function thistype.enumGetTarget )
        return DEST
    endmethod
    //
    private tick main
    private unit caster
    private real damage
    private integer loops
    private static method onFireStart takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        if .loops < 1 or IsUnitType(.caster, UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) then
            set .caster = null
            call .main.destroy()
            return
        endif
        call GetRandomEnemy( .caster, GetUnitX(.caster), GetUnitY(.caster), GetUnitAcquireRange(.caster) + 100 )
        if DEST != null then
            call CMCannonSingle.cast( .caster, GetUnitX(DEST), GetUnitY(DEST), .damage)
        endif
        set DEST = null
        set .loops = .loops - 1
    endmethod
    static method cast takes unit src, real dmg, integer cmb returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.create(0)
        set .caster = src
        set .damage = dmg
        set .loops = cmb
        set .main = this
        call .main.start( 0.20, true, function thistype.onFireStart )
    endmethod

struct CMSwordCamelot extends array

    private unit caster
    private unit target
    private effect fx
    private real damage
    private integer myLoops
    private static method onFinal takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        if not IsUnitType(.target, UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) then
            call UnitRemoveAbility(.target, 'A04Z')
            call UnitRemoveAbility(.target, 'B02F')
        endif
        call DestroyEffect(.fx)
        set .fx = null
        set .caster = null
        set .target = null
        call .mainFlow.destroy()
    endmethod
    private static method onFire takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        if IsUnitType( .caster, UNIT_TYPE_DEAD ) then
            call .mainFlow.start( 1.00, false, function thistype.onFinal )
            return
        endif
        if IsUnitType( .target, UNIT_TYPE_DEAD ) then
            call .mainFlow.start( 1.00, false, function thistype.onFinal )
            return
        endif
        if .myLoops <= 0 then
            call .mainFlow.start( 1.00, false, function thistype.onFinal )
            return
        endif
        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Weapons\\DemonHunterMissile\\DemonHunterMissile.mdl",.target,"chest"))

        set .myLoops = .myLoops - 1
    endmethod
    static method cast takes unit src, unit dst, real dmg, integer loops returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.create(0)
        set .caster = src
        set .target = dst
        set .myLoops = loops
        set .damage = dmg
        set .fx = AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\NightElf\\Immolation\\ImmolationDamage.mdl",dst,"overhead")
        call UnitAddAbility(.target, 'A04Z')
        set .mainFlow = this
        call .mainFlow.start( 1.00, true, function thistype.onFire )
    endmethod
endstruct
