scope TrigFactionTamamoChangeServant initializer main
    globals
        private integer array PICKUP_REQ
    endglobals
    private function ResetChange takes unit u, integer id returns nothing
        call UnitRemoveAbility(u,id)
        call UnitAddAbility(u,id)
    endfunction
    private function KillWisps takes player p, integer cnt returns nothing
        local group g = CreateGroup()
        local unit u
        call GroupEnumUnitsOfPlayer(g,p,null)
        loop
            set u = FirstOfGroup(g)
            exitwhen cnt == 0
            exitwhen u == null
            call GroupRemoveUnit(g,u)
            if not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) then
                if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A02L') > 0 then
                    call SetUnitTimeScale(u,1.00)
                    call KillUnit(u)
                    set cnt = cnt - 1
                endif
            endif
        endloop
        call DestroyGroup(g)
        set g = null
        set u = null
    endfunction
    private function CountWisp takes player p returns integer
        local integer cnt = 0
        local group g = CreateGroup()
        local unit u
        call GroupEnumUnitsOfPlayer(g,p,null)
        loop
            set u = FirstOfGroup(g)
            exitwhen u == null
            call GroupRemoveUnit(g,u)
            if not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) then
                if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A02L') > 0 then
                    set cnt = cnt + 1
                endif
            endif
        endloop
        call DestroyGroup(g)
        set g = null
        return cnt
    endfunction
    private function Pickup takes player p, integer typeId returns nothing
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
        local real x = GetPlayerStartLocationX(Player(id+4))
        local real y = GetPlayerStartLocationY(Player(id+4))
        call servant.add( p, CreateUnit(p,typeId,x,y,270), servant.JOHAB )
    endfunction
    private function OnCast takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))
        local integer lev = GetUnitLevel(GetSpellTargetUnit())
        local integer cnt
        if GetOwningPlayer(GetSpellTargetUnit()) != Player(PLAYER_NEUTRAL_PASSIVE) then
            call StartSoundForPlayerBJ( Player(id), gg_snd_Error )
            call DisplayTextToPlayer(Player(id),0.00,0.00,"|c00FF0000조합표에서 선택 소환할 서번트를 선택해야 합니다.|r")
            call ResetChange(GetTriggerUnit(),GetSpellAbilityId())
        endif
        if IsUnitType(GetSpellTargetUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_SAPPER) then
            call StartSoundForPlayerBJ( Player(id), gg_snd_Error )
            call DisplayTextToPlayer(Player(id),0.00,0.00,"|c00FF0000가챠에서 등장하지 않거나, 뽑기 전용 히든 서번트는 소환할 수 없습니다.|r")
            call ResetChange(GetTriggerUnit(),GetSpellAbilityId())
            return
        endif
        if not IsUnitType(GetSpellTargetUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_TAUREN) then
            call StartSoundForPlayerBJ( Player(id), gg_snd_Error )
            call DisplayTextToPlayer(Player(id),0.00,0.00,"|c00FF0000서번트가 아닌 대상은 선택 소환할 수 없습니다.|r")
            call ResetChange(GetTriggerUnit(),GetSpellAbilityId())
            return
        endif
        if lev > 4 or lev < 1 then
            call StartSoundForPlayerBJ( Player(id), gg_snd_Error )
            call DisplayTextToPlayer(Player(id),0.00,0.00,"|c00FF0000해당 랭크의 서번트는 선택 소환할 수 없습니다.|r")
            call ResetChange(GetTriggerUnit(),GetSpellAbilityId())
            return
        endif
        set cnt = CountWisp(Player(id))
        if cnt < PICKUP_REQ[lev] then
            call StartSoundForPlayerBJ( Player(id), gg_snd_Error )
            call DisplayTextToPlayer(Player(id),0.00,0.00,"|c00FF0000해당 서번트를 소환하기 위해서, 성정석이 "+I2S(PICKUP_REQ[lev]-cnt)+"개 더 필요합니다.|r")
            call ResetChange(GetTriggerUnit(),GetSpellAbilityId())
            return
        endif
        call KillWisps(Player(id), PICKUP_REQ[lev])
        call Pickup(Player(id),GetUnitTypeId(GetSpellTargetUnit()))
    endfunction
    private function main takes nothing returns nothing
        set PICKUP_REQ[1] = 1
        set PICKUP_REQ[2] = 2
        set PICKUP_REQ[3] = 5
        set PICKUP_REQ[4] = 10
        call AbilityEffectEvent.Create( 'A09D', function OnCast )
    endfunction
endscope

scope TrigFactionAlteraSeal initializer main
    globals
        private unit array SEAL_TARGET
        private effect array SEAL_EFFECT
    endglobals
    private function IsUnitAltera takes integer id returns boolean
        if id == '-ALB' then
            return true
        endif
        if id == '-ALA' then
            return true
        endif
        if id == '-ALS' then
            return true
        endif
        if id == '-ALX' then
            return true
        endif
        return false
    endfunction
    private function OnCast takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))
        //서번트가 아니라면 빠꾸
        if not IsUnitType(GetSpellTargetUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_TAUREN) then
            call StartSoundForPlayerBJ( Player(id), gg_snd_Error )
            call DisplayTextToPlayer(Player(id),0.00,0.00,"|c00FF0000서번트가 아닌 대상에게 부여할 수 없는 효과입니다.|r")
            return
        endif
        //문장이 부여되어 있다면 빠꾸
        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(GetSpellTargetUnit(),'A07H') > 0 then
            call StartSoundForPlayerBJ( Player(id), gg_snd_Error )
            call DisplayTextToPlayer(Player(id),0.00,0.00,"|c00FF0000이미 동일한 효과가 부여되어 있습니다.|r")
            return
        endif
        //이전 소유자가 살아 있다면 효과 제거
        if not IsUnitType(SEAL_TARGET[id], UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) and GetUnitTypeId(SEAL_TARGET[id]) != 0 then
            if IsUnitAltera(GetUnitTypeId(SEAL_TARGET[id])) then
                call EVDamageManager.addBonus( SEAL_TARGET[id], -100 )
                call UnitRemoveAbility(SEAL_TARGET[id], 'A0EV')
                call UnitRemoveAbility(SEAL_TARGET[id], 'B00W')
            else
                call EVDamageManager.addBonus( SEAL_TARGET[id], -50 )
                call UnitRemoveAbility(SEAL_TARGET[id], 'A07H')
                call UnitRemoveAbility(SEAL_TARGET[id], 'B003')
            endif
            set SEAL_TARGET[id] = null
        endif
        if SEAL_EFFECT[id] != null then
            call DestroyEffect(SEAL_EFFECT[id])
            set SEAL_EFFECT[id] = null
        endif
        //재설정
        set SEAL_TARGET[id] = GetSpellTargetUnit()
        if IsUnitAltera(GetUnitTypeId(SEAL_TARGET[id])) then
            call bountyTag.custom( Player(id), GetUnitX(SEAL_TARGET[id]),GetUnitY(SEAL_TARGET[id]), "|c00FF0000『유성의 문장+』|r" )
            call UnitAddAbility(SEAL_TARGET[id], 'A0EV')
            call EVDamageManager.addBonus( SEAL_TARGET[id], 100 )
        else
            call bountyTag.custom( Player(id), GetUnitX(SEAL_TARGET[id]),GetUnitY(SEAL_TARGET[id]), "|c00FF0000『유성의 문장』|r" )
            call UnitAddAbility(SEAL_TARGET[id], 'A07H')
            call EVDamageManager.addBonus( SEAL_TARGET[id], 50 )
        endif
        set SEAL_EFFECT[id] = AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\NightElf\\Starfall\\StarfallCaster.mdl",SEAL_TARGET[id],"origin")
    endfunction
    private function main takes nothing returns nothing
        call AbilityEffectEvent.Create( 'A069', function OnCast )
    endfunction

scope TrigFactionBBHoradricCube initializer main
    globals
        //private timer array FUSION_TIMER
        private constant integer FUSION_COUNT = 3
        private hashtable FUSION_TABLE
        private unit array FUSION_BUILDING
        private filterfunc FUSION_FILTER
        
        private group FUSION_GROUP = CreateGroup()
        private player FUSION_PLAYER = null
    endglobals
    private function FusionFilter takes nothing returns boolean
        local integer id
        local integer lev
        local integer max
        if IsUnitType(GetFilterUnit(),UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) or GetFilterUnit() == null then
            return false
        endif
        if not IsUnitType(GetFilterUnit(),UNIT_TYPE_TAUREN) then
            return false
        endif
        if GetOwningPlayer(GetFilterUnit()) != FUSION_PLAYER then
            return false
        endif
        set lev = GetUnitLevel(GetFilterUnit())
        if IsUnitType(GetFilterUnit(),UNIT_TYPE_HERO) then
            set lev = 8
        endif
        if lev < 1 or lev > 5 then
            return false
        endif
        set id = GetPlayerId(FUSION_PLAYER)
        set max = LoadInteger(FUSION_TABLE,lev,-1)
        call SaveUnitHandle(FUSION_TABLE,lev,max,GetFilterUnit())
        call SaveInteger(FUSION_TABLE,lev,-1,max+1)
        return false
    endfunction
    private function VoidFusion takes player p returns nothing
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
        local real x = GetPlayerStartLocationX(p)
        local real y = GetPlayerStartLocationY(p)
        local integer result = 0
        local integer i
        local integer j
        local unit u
        set FUSION_TABLE = InitHashtable()
        set FUSION_PLAYER = p
        call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(FUSION_GROUP,x,y,512.0,FUSION_FILTER)
        call GroupClear(FUSION_GROUP)
        set FUSION_PLAYER = null
        set i = 5
        loop
            if LoadInteger(FUSION_TABLE,i,-1) >= FUSION_COUNT then
                set result = i + 1
                set j = 0
                loop
                    exitwhen j == FUSION_COUNT
                    set u = LoadUnitHandle(FUSION_TABLE,i,j)
                    call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("FX Kiburst\\FX Kiburst Blue.mdl",GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u)))
                    call servant.remove( p, u )
                    call KillUnit( u )
                    call ShowUnit( u, false )
                    set j = j + 1
                endloop
                set u = null
                exitwhen true
            endif
            exitwhen i == 1
            set i = i - 1
        endloop
        call FlushParentHashtable(FUSION_TABLE)
        set FUSION_TABLE = null
        if result == 0 then
            //call SetPlayerState(p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER,GetPlayerState(p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER)+1)
            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0.0,0.0,10.0,"|c00FF4040최소 "+I2S(FUSION_COUNT)+"명의 동일 등급 유닛이 융합진 위에 존재해야 합니다.|r")
            return
        endif
        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("FX\\ShadowAssault.mdl",x,y))

//===================================================
//      N명의 지정된 A급 서번트를 모으면 EX급 해금
//===================================================
scope TrigFactionBBUnlock initializer main
    globals
        private constant integer MAX_REQUIRED = 5
        
        private hashtable REQ_TABLE = InitHashtable()
        private integer array REQ_SIZE
        private integer array REQ_TYPE
        private integer array REQ_COUNT
        
        private boolean array UNLOCKED
        
        private unit array REQUIRED_UNIT
        private unit array RESULT_UNIT
    endglobals
    private function CheckReqUnit takes player p returns boolean
        local integer pid = p:PlayerId
        local integer size = pid:REQ_SIZE
        local integer i = 0
        local integer typ
        local integer have
        local integer max
        local integer ins
        local boolean result = true
        loop
            exitwhen i == size
            set typ = REQ_TYPE[pid*MAX_REQUIRED+i]
            set have = GetPlayerUnitTypeCount(p,typ)
            set max = REQ_COUNT[pid*MAX_REQUIRED+i]
            set ins = max - have
            if ins > 0 then
                call DisplayTextToPlayer(p,0.0,0.0,"|cffff4040"+trimmer.get(typ)+" "+I2S(ins)+"기 부족!|r")
                set result = false
            endif
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
        return result
    endfunction
    private function AddReqUnit takes player p, integer id returns nothing
        local integer pid = p:PlayerId
        local integer size = pid:REQ_SIZE
        if HaveSavedInteger(REQ_TABLE,pid,id) then
            set size = LoadInteger(REQ_TABLE,pid,id)
            set REQ_COUNT[pid*MAX_REQUIRED+size] = REQ_COUNT[pid*MAX_REQUIRED+size] + 1
        else
            set REQ_TYPE[pid*MAX_REQUIRED+size] = id
            set REQ_COUNT[pid*MAX_REQUIRED+size] = 1
            call SaveInteger(REQ_TABLE,pid,id,size)
            set pid:REQ_SIZE = size + 1
        endif
    endfunction
    private function GenRandomEXClass takes player p returns nothing
        local integer pid = p:PlayerId
        local real x = p:StartLocationX
        local real y = p:StartLocationY
        local unit u = gacha.do( FX_PLAYER_DUMMY, 7, x, y, 270.0 )
        call UnitAddAbility(u,'Aloc')
        call UnitAddAbility(u,'Apiv')
        set pid:RESULT_UNIT = u
        set u = null
    endfunction
    private function GenRandomAClasses takes player p returns nothing
        local integer pid = p:PlayerId
        local integer i = 0
        local real angle = 270.0
        local real x = p:StartLocationX
        local real y = p:StartLocationY
        local unit u
        loop
            exitwhen i == MAX_REQUIRED
            set u = gacha.do( FX_PLAYER_DUMMY, 5, x + 384.0*Cos(angle*bj_DEGTORAD), y + 384.0*Sin(angle*bj_DEGTORAD), 270.0 )
            call UnitAddAbility(u,'Aloc')
            call UnitAddAbility(u,'Apiv')
            set REQUIRED_UNIT[pid*MAX_REQUIRED+i] = u
            call AddReqUnit(p,u:UnitId)
            set angle = angle + (360.0 / MAX_REQUIRED)
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
        set u = null
    endfunction
    private function UnlockBBServant takes player p returns nothing
        local integer pid = p:PlayerId
        local integer i = 0
        local real x = p:StartLocationX
        local real y = p:StartLocationY
        local unit u
        loop
            exitwhen i == MAX_REQUIRED
            call ShowUnit(REQUIRED_UNIT[pid*MAX_REQUIRED+i],false)
            call KillUnit(REQUIRED_UNIT[pid*MAX_REQUIRED+i])
            set REQUIRED_UNIT[pid*MAX_REQUIRED+i] = null
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
        set u = CreateUnit( p, pid:RESULT_UNIT:UnitId, x, y, 270.0 )
        call servant.add( p, u, servant.BOUNTY )
        /*call SetUnitVertexColor(u,32,32,32,255) // 3.80.9 더 이상 미명 완전체 버프를 부여하지 않음
        call UnitAddAbility(u,'A0GO')
        call UnitAddAbility(u,'A0GN')
        call EVDamageManager.addBonus( u, 50 )*/
        set u = null
        call ShowUnit(pid:RESULT_UNIT,false)
        call KillUnit(pid:RESULT_UNIT)
        set pid:RESULT_UNIT = null
    endfunction
    /*=================================================*/
    private function OnCheckUnlock takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer id = GetTriggerUnit():OwnerId  /*REF-LEAK-FREE*/
        if FXGetPlayerCurrentFaction(id:ToPlayer) != FX_FACTION_BB then
            return
        endif
        if id:UNLOCKED then
            return
        endif
        if not CheckReqUnit(id:ToPlayer) then
            call DisplayTextToPlayer(id:ToPlayer,0.0,0.0,"획득 예정 서번트 : "+trimmer.get(id:RESULT_UNIT:UnitId)+"|r")
            call StartSoundForPlayerBJ(id:ToPlayer,gg_snd_Error)
            return
        endif
        set id:UNLOCKED = true
        call StartSoundForPlayerBJ(id:ToPlayer,gg_snd_gacha_rare)
        call UnitRemoveAbility(GetTriggerUnit(),'A0GX')
        call UnlockBBServant(id:ToPlayer)
    endfunction
    private function OnConvBuilding takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer pid = GetPlayerId(eventCustom.getTriggerPlayer()) /*REF-LEAK-FREE*/
        if FXGetPlayerCurrentFaction(pid:ToPlayer) != FX_FACTION_BB then
            return
        endif
        // 플레이어가 죽었다면 아무것도 하지 않습니다
        if not USER_IS_PLAYING[pid] then
            return
        endif
        call GenRandomEXClass(pid:ToPlayer)
        call GenRandomAClasses(pid:ToPlayer)
    endfunction
    /*=================================================*/
    private function main takes nothing returns nothing
        call AbilityEffectEvent.Create( 'A0GX', function OnCheckUnlock )
        call eventCustom.addAction( EVENT_PLAYER_BUILDING_SLOT_3, function OnConvBuilding )
    endfunction
endscope

struct TLBBSSAllKill extends array
    private tick main
    private unit caster
    private unit myDummy
    private real myDmg
    private static method EnumSplash takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        if not IsUnitType(GetEnumUnit(),UNIT_TYPE_UNDEAD) then
            return
        endif
        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("FX\\Atalanta\\Ray.mdl",GetUnitX(GetEnumUnit()),GetUnitY(GetEnumUnit())))
        call enemy.dealLogic( .caster, GetEnumUnit(), .myDmg, WEAPON_TYPE_METAL_HEAVY_BASH, 1 )
    endmethod
    private static method onFire takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        if not IsUnitDead(.caster) then
            set .myDmg = GetHeroInt(.caster,true) * 1000.0
            call KillUnit(CreateUnit(Player(PLAYER_NEUTRAL_PASSIVE),'o01Z',GetUnitX(.myDummy),GetUnitY(.myDummy),270.00))
            call TLBBSSAllKillRayFx.apply(GetUnitX(.myDummy),GetUnitY(.myDummy))
            call SetSoundPosition( gg_snd_HowlOfTerror, GetUnitX(.myDummy),GetUnitY(.myDummy), 300.0 )
            call StartSound( gg_snd_HowlOfTerror )
            call splash.rect( splash.ENEMY, .caster, GetWorldBounds(), function thistype.EnumSplash )
        endif
        set .myDummy = null
        set .caster = null
        call .main.destroy()
    endmethod
    static method apply takes unit src returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.create(0)
        set .caster = src
        set .main = this
        set .myDummy = CreateUnit( Player(PLAYER_NEUTRAL_PASSIVE), 'o025', GetUnitX(src), GetUnitY(src), GetUnitFacing(src) )
        call SetUnitAnimation(.myDummy, "Spell Attack")
        call TLDummyLife.apply( .myDummy, 1.90 )
        call TLDummyFade.apply( .myDummy, 255, 255, 255, 0, 255, 255, 255, 128, 0.50 )
        call TLDummyFadespan.apply( .myDummy, 255, 255, 255, 128, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1.40,1.90)
        call .main.start( 1.40, true, function thistype.onFire )
    endmethod
endstruct
struct TLBBSSAllKillRayFx extends array
    private tick main
    private real X
    private real Y
    private real D1
    private real D2
    private static method onFire takes nothing returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.getExpired()
        local real angle
        local integer i = 0
        local integer imax = R2I(.D1) / 384
        loop
            exitwhen i > imax
            set angle = GetRandomReal(0.0,360.0)
            call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("FX\\Atalanta\\Ray.mdl",.X+Polar.X(.D1,angle),.Y+Polar.Y(.D1,angle)))
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
        set .D1 = .D1 + 128
        if .D1 < .D2 then
            return
        endif
        call .main.destroy()
    endmethod
    static method apply takes real x, real y returns nothing
        local thistype this = tick.create(0)
        set .main = this
        set .X = x
        set .Y = y
        set .D1 = 256.0
        set .D2 = 22624.0
        call .main.start( 0.03125, true, function thistype.onFire )
    endmethod
endstruct

    endfunction

        local integer i = 1
        local integer c = 0

            exitwhen i > FX_FACTION_MAX

                set c = c + 1

            set i = i + 1
        endloop
        return c

        return FACTION_XP[GetPlayerId(p)*FX_FACTION_MAX+fact]

        call FXSetXpCalc( FXGetPlayerFactionLevel(p, fact), FXGetPlayerFactionXp(p, fact), amount )
        call FXSetPlayerFactionLevel(p, fact, FXGetXpCalcLv() )
        call FXSetPlayerFactionXp(p, fact, FXGetXpCalcXp() )
        if FXGetXpCalcLv() == FX_FACTION_MAX_LEVEL then
            call FXPromotePlayerMaster(p)
        endif
    endfunction

//　　local integer i = FXGetPlayerXp( player )

        endif
        return FXGetPlayerFactionLevel(p,f)
    endfunction
    function FXGetPlayerXp takes player p returns integer
        local fxFaction f = PLAYER_FACTION[GetPlayerId(p)]
        if FXIsPlayerFactionMastered(p,f) then
            return FXGetPlayerMasterXp(p)
        endif
        return FXGetPlayerFactionXp(p,f)
    endfunction
    function FXAddPlayerXp takes player p, integer amount returns nothing
        local fxFaction f = PLAYER_FACTION[GetPlayerId(p)]
        if FXIsPlayerFactionMastered(p,f) then
            call FXAddPlayerMasterXp(p,amount)
        else
            call FXAddPlayerFactionXp(p,f,amount)
        endif
    endfunction

        local real 점유율 = GetIndexRate()
            ＋시스템 최대 수용량인 8191에 대한 인덱싱된 유닛의 점유율을 %로 구해줍니다.
            
        local trigger 트리거 = GetUnitRemoveTrigger(유닛)
            ＋인덱싱된 유닛에 대한 '유닛 제거됨' 이벤트에 대응되는 트리거 핸들을 빌려옵니다.
            －만약 null이 반환되었다면. null 또는 이미 제거되었거나, 인덱싱 하지 않은 유닛입니다. 
        
        local integer 유닛번호 = GetTriggerIndex()
            ＋GetUnitRemoveTrigger()의 유닛 제거 이벤트에 대응하는, 제거된 유닛의 고유번호입니다.
            －주의! GetUnitRemoveTrigger() 액션을 제외한 다른 이벤트의 액션에서는 0으로 작동합니다
*/
//=====================================================================
library UnitIndexer initializer main
    globals
        private hashtable H = InitHashtable()
        private integer M = 0
        private integer array S
        private integer array I
        private unit array U
        private integer Z = 0
    endglobals
    //=========================================
    //  +a. 성능 평가
    //=========================================
    globals
        private integer C = 0
    endglobals
    function GetIndexRate takes nothing returns real
        return C / 8191.0
    endfunction
    //=========================================
    //  디인덱스 이벤트
    //=========================================
    globals
        private integer V = 0
        private trigger array E
    endglobals
    function GetTriggerIndex takes nothing returns integer
        return V
    endfunction
    function GetUnitRemoveTrigger takes unit u returns trigger
        return E[LoadInteger(H,0,GetHandleId(u))]
    endfunction
    //=========================================
    //  1/3. 디인덱서
    //=========================================
    private function Deindex takes integer id returns nothing
        local integer pi = V
        set V = id
        call TriggerExecute(E[id])
        set V = pi
        call DestroyTrigger(E[id])
        call RemoveSavedInteger(H,0,I[id])
        set E[id] = null
        set U[id] = null
        set I[id] = 0
        set S[Z] = id
        set Z = Z + 1
        set C = C - 1
    endfunction
    //=========================================
    //  2/3. MUI화된 인덱서 리프레셔
    //=========================================
        globals
            private timer array T
            private trigger array T1
            private triggeraction array T1A
        endglobals
        private function DRef takes integer id returns nothing
            call RemoveSavedInteger(H,0,GetHandleId(T[id]))
            call RemoveSavedInteger(H,0,GetHandleId(T1[id]))
            call DestroyTimer(T[id])
            set T[id] = null
            call TriggerRemoveAction(T1[id],T1A[id])
            set T1A[id] = null
            call DestroyTrigger(T1[id])
            set T1[id] = null
        endfunction
        private function ORem takes nothing returns nothing
            local integer id = LoadInteger(H,0,GetHandleId(GetExpiredTimer()))
            if GetUnitTypeId(U[id]) != 0 then
                if IsUnitType(U[id],UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) then
                    call TimerStart(T[id],5.0,false,function ORem)
                    return
                endif
                return
            endif
            call DRef(id)
            call Deindex(id)
        endfunction
        private function ODea takes nothing returns nothing
            local integer id = LoadInteger(H,0,GetHandleId(GetTriggeringTrigger()))
            call TimerStart(T[id],1.0,false,function ORem)
        endfunction
        private function ARef takes unit u, integer id returns nothing
            set T[id] = CreateTimer()
            call SaveInteger(H,0,GetHandleId(T[id]),id)
            set T1[id] = CreateTrigger()
            set T1A[id] = TriggerAddAction(T1[id], function ODea)
            call SaveInteger(H,0,GetHandleId(T1[id]),id)
            call TriggerRegisterUnitEvent(T1[id],u,EVENT_UNIT_DEATH)
            if IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) then
                call TimerStart(T[id],5.0,false,function ORem)
            endif
        endfunction
    //=========================================
    //  3/3. 인덱서
    //=========================================
    function GetUnitIndex takes unit u returns integer
        return LoadInteger(H,0,GetHandleId(u))
    endfunction
    function IsUnitIndexed takes unit u returns boolean
        return HaveSavedInteger(H,0,GetHandleId(u))
    endfunction
    function IndexUnit takes unit u returns integer
        local integer id = LoadInteger(H,0,GetHandleId(u))
        if id == 0 then
            if GetUnitTypeId(u) == 0 then
                return 0
            endif
            if Z == 0 then
                set M = M + 1
                set id = M
            else
                set Z = Z - 1
                set id = S[Z]
            endif
            set C = C + 1
            set U[id] = u
            set I[id] = GetHandleId(u)
            set E[id] = CreateTrigger()
            call SaveInteger(H,0,GetHandleId(u),id)
            call ARef( u, id )
        endif
        return id
    endfunction
    //=========================================
    //  +a. 프리인덱서/포스트인덱서
    //=========================================
    private function OnAllocateCondition takes nothing returns boolean
        return not HaveSavedInteger(H,0,GetHandleId(GetTriggerUnit()))
    endfunction
    private function OnAllocateAction takes nothing returns nothing
        call IndexUnit(GetTriggerUnit())
    endfunction
    private function PostAllocate takes nothing returns nothing
        local trigger t = CreateTrigger()
        call TriggerAddAction(t, function OnAllocateAction)
        call TriggerAddCondition(t, Condition(function OnAllocateCondition))
        call TriggerRegisterEnterRectSimple(t, GetWorldBounds())
        set t = null
    endfunction
    private function EnumPreAllocate takes nothing returns boolean
        call IndexUnit( GetFilterUnit() )
        return false
    endfunction
    private function PreAllocate takes nothing returns nothing
        local group g = CreateGroup()
        call GroupEnumUnitsInRect(g,GetWorldBounds(),Filter(function EnumPreAllocate))
        call DestroyGroup( g )
        set g = null
    endfunction
    private function main takes nothing returns nothing
        call PreAllocate()
        call PostAllocate()
    endfunction
endlibrary

struct EVUnitRemove
    private static constant integer STRUCT_ID = 1
    private trigger TR
    //API
    static method bind takes unit src, code c returns triggeraction
        local integer id = GetUnitUserData( src )
        local hashtable idTab = GetCustomDataTable( id )
        local integer idKey = GetCustomDataKey( id )
        local thistype this = LoadInteger(idTab, 0, idKey + STRUCT_ID)
        return TriggerBindAction( .TR, c, null )
    endmethod
    static method append takes unit src returns nothing
        local integer id = GetUnitUserData( src )
        local hashtable idTab = GetCustomDataTable( id )
        local integer idKey = GetCustomDataKey( id )
        call new( idTab, idKey, src )
        set idTab = null
    endmethod
    //생성자, 소멸자
    private static method new takes hashtable idTab, integer idKey, unit src returns nothing
        local thistype this = thistype.allocate()
        set .TR = CreateTrigger()
        call SaveInteger( idTab, 0, idKey + STRUCT_ID, this )
        set ARU[ARMX] = src
        set ARID[ARMX] = GetUnitUserData( src )
        set ARMX = ARMX + 1
        if TB then
            set TB = false
            set TC = 0
            call TimerStart( T, 0.04, true, function thistype.onCallback )
        endif
    endmethod
    //구현부
    private static method onFire takes integer id returns nothing
        local integer prevE = e
        local hashtable idTab = GetCustomDataTable( id )
        local integer idKey = GetCustomDataKey( id )
        local thistype this = LoadInteger(idTab, 0, idKey + STRUCT_ID)
        set e = id
        call TriggerExecute( .TR )
        set e = prevE
        call DestroyTrigger( .TR )
        call SaveInteger( idTab, 0, idKey + STRUCT_ID, 0 )
        call thistype.deallocate(this)
        set .TR = null
    endmethod
    
    static integer e = 0
    
    private static integer ARMX = 0
    private static integer array ARID
    private static unit array ARU
    
    private static timer T = CreateTimer()
    private static boolean TB = true
    private static integer TC = 0
    
    private static method onCallback takes nothing returns nothing
        if TC >= ARMX then
            debug call DisplayTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(), 0, 0, "남은 몹 : "+I2S(ARMX))
            set TC = 0
            if ARMX == 0 then
                set TB = true
                call PauseTimer(T)
                return
            endif
        endif
        if GetUnitTypeId( ARU[TC] ) != 0 then
            set TC = TC + 1
            return
        endif
        call onFire( ARID[TC] )
        set ARMX = ARMX - 1
        set ARU[TC] = ARU[ARMX]
        set ARID[TC] = ARID[ARMX]
        set ARU[ARMX] = null
        set ARID[ARMX] = 0
    endmethod
endstruct

    private unit SRC

    private static method new takes hashtable idTab, integer idKey, unit src returns nothing

            call DestroyEffect(.FX)
            set .FX = null

            set .DST = null

        call DestroyTrigger(.ONSMART)
        set .ONSMART = null

        set .ONCAST = null

        set .ONFINISH = null

        set .ONRM = null

        set .SRC = null
        set idTab = null
        call thistype.deallocate(this)
    endmethod
    //구현부
    private static method onSmart takes nothing returns boolean
        local integer id
        local integer lv
        local real x
        local real y
        local real px
        local real py
        if GetIssuedOrderId() != OrderId("smart") then
            return false
        endif
        if GetOrderTarget() != null then
            set x = GetWidgetX(GetOrderTarget())
            set y = GetWidgetY(GetOrderTarget())
        else
            set x = GetOrderPointX()
            set y = GetOrderPointY()
        endif
        set id = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetOrderedUnit()))
        if IsTerrainPathable(x, y, PATHING_TYPE_WALKABILITY) then
            set lv = GetUnitLevel( GetOrderedUnit() )
            if IsUnitType(GetOrderedUnit(),UNIT_TYPE_HERO) then
                set lv = 8
            endif
            if IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE[id], x, y ) then
                return false
            endif
            if FXGetPlayerServantSellSetting(Player(id)) == 0 then
                return false
            endif
            if FXGetPlayerServantSellSetting(Player(id)) == 1 then
                if lv > 3 then
                    return false
                endif
            endif
            if FXGetPlayerServantSellSetting(Player(id)) == 2 then
                if lv > 5 then
                    return false
                endif
            endif
            call IssueImmediateOrder( GetOrderedUnit(), "neutralinteract" )
            return false
        endif
        if not IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE[id], x, y ) then
            return false
        endif
        set px = GetUnitX(GetOrderedUnit())
        set py = GetUnitY(GetOrderedUnit())
        if IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE1[0], x, y ) and IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE1[0], px, py )  then
            return false
        endif
        if IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE1[1], x, y ) and IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE1[1], px, py )  then
            return false
        endif
        if IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE1[2], x, y ) and IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE1[2], px, py )  then
            return false
        endif
        if IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE1[3], x, y ) and IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE1[3], px, py )  then
            return false
        endif
        if IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE2[id], x, y ) and IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE2[id], px, py )  then
            return false
        endif
        if IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE3[id], x, y ) and IsPointInRegion( ZONE_TELEPORTABLE3[id], px, py )  then
            return false
        endif
        call IssuePointOrder( GetOrderedUnit(), "mount", x, y )
        return false
    endmethod

        set .myPosX = GetUnitX(src)

        set .myMotionIndex = mdex

        call .myRoute.calc( .myMoveDist )
        call SetUnitX( src, .myRoute.X )
        call SetUnitY( src, .myRoute.Y )
        set .myFacing = .myRoute.R
        call SetUnitFacing( src, .myFacing )

        call SetUnitTimeScale( .mySource, GetUnitMoveSpeed( .mySource ) * 0.01 * 0.80 )
        if .myMoveDist > .myRoute.distance then
            set .myMoveDist = .myMoveDist - .myRoute.distance
            call .rePath()
        endif
        call .myRoute.calc( .myMoveDist )
        call SetUnitX( .mySource, .myRoute.X )
        call SetUnitY( .mySource, .myRoute.Y )
        if .myRoute.R != .myFacing then
            set .myFacing = .myRoute.R

        call .myRoute.add( .myPosX, .myPosY )
        call .myRoute.add( GetRandomReal(minX,maxX), GetRandomReal(minY,maxY) )
        call .myRoute.add( GetRandomReal(minX,maxX), GetRandomReal(minY,maxY) )
        call .myRoute.add( GetRandomReal(minX,maxX), GetRandomReal(minY,maxY) )
        set .myPosX = GetRandomReal(minX,maxX)
        set .myPosY = GetRandomReal(minY,maxY)

library FXRDmetadata requires FXRD

    globals
        constant key EVENT_GAME_INIT
        constant key EVENT_GAME_ROUND
        constant key EVENT_USER_KILL
        constant key EVENT_USER_LINEMOB_DEATH
        constant key EVENT_USER_LINEMOB_KILL
        
        unit array FXRD_TOWER
        unit array FXRD_SPECIAL_TOWER
        integer array FXRD_SCORE
        integer FXRD_SCORE_BEST = 0
        integer array FXRD_LIFE
        integer array FXRD_WAVE
        integer FXRD_WAVE_BEST = 0
        integer array FXRD_AUTOWISP
        integer array FXRD_SERVANT_BEST
        integer array FXRD_ROUND_ID
        integer array FXRD_ROUND_MOV
        
        integer array ENEMY_REMAIN
        integer array ENEMY_WAVE_STACK
        integer array ENEMY_WAVE_WORKING
        
        real array FXRD_CLEAR_TIME
        integer FXRD_CLEAR_RANK = 1
        boolean array FXRD_CLEARED
        
        boolean FXRD_UNION_WAVE = true
        boolean FXRD_UNION_LINE = false
        boolean FXRD_UNION_LIFE = false
    endglobals
    
    function AddPlayerMp takes player p, real amt returns nothing
        call DestroyEffect( AddSpecialEffect( "Abilities\\Spells\\Items\\AIma\\AImaTarget.mdl", GetUnitX(FXRD_TOWER[GetPlayerId(p)]), GetUnitY(FXRD_TOWER[GetPlayerId(p)]) ) )
        call SetUnitState( FXRD_TOWER[GetPlayerId(p)], UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetUnitState( FXRD_TOWER[GetPlayerId(p)], UNIT_STATE_MANA ) + amt )
    endfunction
    function CheckPlayerMp takes player p returns nothing
        if GetUnitState( FXRD_TOWER[GetPlayerId(p)], UNIT_STATE_MANA ) >= GetUnitState( FXRD_TOWER[GetPlayerId(p)], UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA ) then
            call DisplayTextToPlayer( p, 0.00, 0.00, "|c00ff4040마나가 가득 찼습니다|r" )
        endif
    endfunction
    
    function CountInGameUser takes nothing returns integer
        local integer id = 0
        local integer c = 0
        loop
            exitwhen id == 4
            if USER_IS_PLAYING[id] then
                set c = c + 1
            endif
            set id = id + 1
        endloop
        return c
    endfunction
    
    function AddUserScore takes player p, integer i returns nothing
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
        set FXRD_SCORE[id] = FXRD_SCORE[id] + i
        if FXRD_SCORE[id] > FXRD_SCORE_BEST then
            set FXRD_SCORE_BEST = FXRD_SCORE[id]
        endif
    endfunction
    
    function GetUserWave takes player p returns integer
        if FXRD_UNION_WAVE then
            return FXRD_WAVE[11]
        else
            return FXRD_WAVE[GetPlayerId(p)]
        endif
    endfunction
    
    function SetUserWave takes player p, integer s returns nothing
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
        if FXRD_UNION_WAVE then
            set id = 11
        endif
        set FXRD_WAVE[id] = s
        if FXRD_WAVE[id] > FXRD_WAVE_BEST then
            set FXRD_WAVE_BEST = FXRD_WAVE[id]
        endif
    endfunction
    
    function GetUserLife takes player p returns integer
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
        local integer myMaxLife = FXRD_LIFE[id]
        local integer myLife = ENEMY_REMAIN[id+4]
        if FXRD_UNION_LIFE then
            set myMaxLife = FXRD_LIFE[11]
            set myLife = ENEMY_REMAIN[11]
        endif
        return myMaxLife - myLife
    endfunction
    
    function GetUserLifeString takes player p returns string
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
        local integer myMaxLife = FXRD_LIFE[id]
        local integer myLife = ENEMY_REMAIN[id+4]
        local integer danger = 40
        if FXRD_UNION_LIFE then
            set myMaxLife = FXRD_LIFE[11]
            set myLife = ENEMY_REMAIN[11]
            set danger = danger * CountInGameUser()
        endif
        if GetPanalty(PANALTY_ENEMY_BONUS) then
            set danger = danger * 2
        endif
        set myLife = myMaxLife - myLife
        if myLife <= 0 then
            return "|c00FF0000" + I2S(myLife) + "|r"
        endif
        if myLife <= danger then
            return "|c00FFFF00" + I2S(myLife) + "|r"
        endif
        if myLife < myMaxLife then
            return I2S(myLife)
        endif
        return "|c0000FF00" + I2S(myLife) + "|r"
    endfunction
    
endlibrary

library FXWisp
    globals
        private hashtable WISP_MODELS = InitHashtable()
    endglobals
    private struct WispModelsInitializer extends array
        private static method onInit takes nothing returns nothing
            call SaveInteger(WISP_MODELS,StringHash("escaco"),0,'A0HB')
            // Credits
            call SaveInteger(WISP_MODELS,StringHash("Arterion"),0,'A0HB')
            call SaveInteger(WISP_MODELS,StringHash("Vo.Shecil"),0,'A0HB')
            call SaveInteger(WISP_MODELS,StringHash("Morikubo"),0,'A0HA')
        endmethod
    endstruct
    function CreateWisp takes player p, integer amt returns nothing
        local integer i = 0
        local integer order = FXRD_AUTOWISP[GetPlayerId(p)]
        local real x = -6144.00
        local real y = 0
        local boolean hasSkin = HaveSavedInteger(WISP_MODELS,StringHash(USER_NAME[GetPlayerId(p)]),0)
        local integer skin = LoadInteger(WISP_MODELS,StringHash(USER_NAME[GetPlayerId(p)]),0)
        local unit u
        loop
            exitwhen i >= amt
            set u = CreateUnit(p, 'wisp', x, y, 270)
            call UnitAddAbility( u, 'A02L' )
            call SetUnitTimeScale(u, 0.0)
            if GetLocalPlayer() != p then
                call SetUnitVertexColor(u,255,255,255,32)
                call SetUnitScale(u,0.1,0.1,0.1)
            endif
            if hasSkin then
                call UnitAddAbility(u,skin)
            endif
            if order > 0 then
                call IssuePointOrder( u, "move", x+Polar.X(512.00,90.00*order), y+Polar.Y(512.00,90.00*order) )
            endif
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
        set u = null
    endfunction
endlibrary

library FXStatusBoard requires FXRDmetadata
    struct statusBoard extends array
        private static constant real SIZE_KILL = 0.03
        private static board BOARD = 0
        private static string array NAME
        static method init takes nothing returns nothing
            set BOARD = board.create(  )
            set BOARD.title = "게임 상황판"
            set BOARD.width = 4
            set BOARD.height = 6
            call BOARD.setStyle( true, false )
            call layout()
            call cell()
        endmethod
        private static method cell takes nothing returns nothing
            local integer i = 0
            loop
                exitwhen i == 4
                set BOARD[0][i+1].scale = 0.08
                set BOARD[1][i+1].scale = 0.03
                set BOARD[2][i+1].scale = SIZE_KILL
                set BOARD[3][i+1].scale = 0.10
                set i = i + 1
            endloop
        endmethod
        private static method layout takes nothing returns nothing
            set BOARD[0][0].value = "|c00ffcc00플레이어 이름|r"
            set BOARD[0][0].scale = 0.08
            set BOARD[1][0].value = "|c00ffcc00라이프|r"
            set BOARD[1][0].scale = 0.03
            set BOARD[2][0].value = "|c00ffcc00킬 수|r"
            set BOARD[2][0].scale = SIZE_KILL
            set BOARD[3][0].value = "|c00ffcc00세력/자원|r"
            set BOARD[3][0].scale = 0.10
            set BOARD[0][5].scale = 0.08
            set BOARD[1][5].scale = 0.15
            set BOARD[2][5].scale = 0.01
            set BOARD[3][5].scale = 0.01
        endmethod
        //===================================================
        static method operator time= takes string s returns nothing
            set BOARD[0][5].value = s
        endmethod
        static method operator difficulty= takes string s returns nothing
            set BOARD[1][5].value = s
        endmethod
        static method operator super takes nothing returns board
            return BOARD
        endmethod
        static method setName takes integer i, string s returns nothing
            set NAME[i] = s
            set BOARD[0][i+1].value = s
        endmethod
        static method getName takes integer i returns string
            return NAME[i]
        endmethod
        static method setPrefix takes integer i, string s returns nothing
            set BOARD[0][i+1].value = s+NAME[i]
        endmethod
        static method setIcon takes integer i, string s returns nothing
            call BOARD[0][i+1].setStyle(true,true)
            set BOARD[0][i+1].icon = s
        endmethod
        static method setLife takes integer i, string s returns nothing
            set BOARD[1][i+1].value = s
        endmethod
        static method setStat takes integer i, string s returns nothing
            set BOARD[3][i+1].value = s
        endmethod
        static method show takes boolean flag returns nothing
            set BOARD.visible = flag
        endmethod
        static method removePlayer takes player p returns nothing
            local integer id = GetPlayerId( p )
            call setName( id, "|c00808080 - 패배 -|r" )
            call setIcon( id, "ReplaceableTextures\\CommandButtons\\BTNCancel.blp" )
            set BOARD[2][id+1].value = ""
            call setLife( id, "" )
            call setStat( id, "" )
        endmethod
            
        static method finishWave takes player p returns nothing
            local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
            local string array prefix
            set prefix[1] = "|c0040FF40[Ace]|r"
            set prefix[2] = "[2nd]"
            set prefix[3] = "[3rd]"
            set prefix[4] = "[4th]"
            if USER_IS_PLAYING[id] then
                set FXRD_CLEARED[id] = true
                set BOARD[0][id+1].value = prefix[FXRD_CLEAR_RANK]+NAME[id]
                set FXRD_CLEAR_RANK = FXRD_CLEAR_RANK + 1
            endif
        endmethod
        static method refreshWave takes nothing returns nothing
            local integer i = 0
            local integer wav
            loop
                exitwhen i == 4
                if USER_IS_PLAYING[i] and not FXGameResult[i].Resulted then
                    set wav = GetUserWave(Player(i))
                    if wav == FXRD_WAVE_BEST then
                        set BOARD[0][i+1].value = "|c0040FF40["+I2S(wav)+"R]|r"+NAME[i]
                    else
                        set BOARD[0][i+1].value = "["+I2S(wav)+"R]"+NAME[i]
                    endif
                endif
                set i = i + 1
            endloop
        endmethod
        static method refreshKill takes nothing returns nothing
            local integer i = 0
            loop
                exitwhen i == 4
                if USER_IS_PLAYING[i] then
                    if FXRD_SCORE[i] == FXRD_SCORE_BEST then
                        set BOARD[2][i+1].value = "|c0040FF40"+I2S(FXRD_SCORE[i])+"|r"
                    else
                        set BOARD[2][i+1].value = I2S(FXRD_SCORE[i])
                    endif
                endif
                set i = i + 1
            endloop
        endmethod
        static method refreshLife takes nothing returns nothing
            local integer i = 0
            loop
                exitwhen i == 4
                if USER_IS_PLAYING[i] then
                    call statusBoard.setLife( i, GetUserLifeString(Player(i)) )
                endif
                set i = i + 1
            endloop
        endmethod
        static method refreshStat takes nothing returns nothing
            local integer i = 0
            local fxFaction myFax
            loop
                exitwhen i == 4
                if USER_IS_PLAYING[i] then
                    set myFax = FXGetPlayerCurrentFaction(Player(i))
                    if FXIsPlayerCurrentFactionMastered(Player(i)) then
                        call statusBoard.setStat( i, FXGetFactionMasterName(myFax)+" (|c00FFFF00"+I2S(GetPlayerGold(Player(i)))+"G|r/|c004040FF"+I2S(GetPlayerLumber(Player(i)))+"S|r)" )
                    else
                        call statusBoard.setStat( i, FXGetFactionName(myFax)+" (|c00FFFF00"+I2S(GetPlayerGold(Player(i)))+"G|r/|c004040FF"+I2S(GetPlayerLumber(Player(i)))+"S|r)" )
                    endif
                endif
                set i = i + 1
            endloop
        endmethod
        static method refreshNameIcon takes nothing returns nothing
            local integer i = 0
            local fxFaction myFax
            loop
                exitwhen i == 4
                if USER_IS_PLAYING[i] then
                    set myFax = FXGetPlayerCurrentFaction(Player(i))
                    call statusBoard.setName( i, pcs.get(Player(i)) )
                    if FXIsPlayerCurrentFactionMastered(Player(i)) then
                        call statusBoard.setIcon( i, FXGetFactionMasterIcon(myFax) )
                    else
                        call statusBoard.setIcon( i, FXGetFactionIcon(myFax) )
                    endif
                endif
                set i = i + 1
            endloop
        endmethod
        
        static method refreshAll takes nothing returns nothing
            call refreshNameIcon()
            call refreshStat()
            call refreshLife()
            call refreshKill()
        endmethod
    endstruct
    
endlibrary

    private function onEnemyDamaged takes nothing returns nothing
        local unit src
        local unit dst
        local boolean p_attacking
        local string tags
        if GetEventDamage() == 0 then
            return
        endif
        set src = GetEventDamageSource()
        set dst = GetTriggerUnit()
        if IsPlayerAlly(GetOwningPlayer(src),GetOwningPlayer(dst)) then
            set src = null
            set dst = null
            return
        endif
        if not DEAL_FLAG_ATTACKING then
            set p_attacking = DEAL_FLAG_ATTACKING
            set DEAL_FLAG_ATTACKING = true
            call UnitDamageTarget( dst, src, 0.00, true, false, ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS, DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL, WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS )
            set DEAL_FLAG_ATTACKING = p_attacking
        endif
        if DEAL_FLAG_LOGIC then
            if IsUnitType( dst, UNIT_TYPE_GIANT ) then
                set tags = I2S(R2I(GetEventDamage() * 10))
            else
                set tags = I2S(R2I(GetEventDamage()))
            endif
            if GetEventDamage() < 1 then
                set tags = "|c00808080GUARD!|r"
            endif
            call damageTag( GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(src)), tags, GetUnitX(dst), GetUnitY(dst) )
        endif
        set src = null
        set dst = null
    endfunction

    struct enemy extends array
        static method add takes player p, unit u returns nothing
            call SetUnitMoveSpeed( u, GetUnitDefaultMoveSpeed(u)*LEVEL_SPEED[LEVEL_CURRENT] )
            call UnitIndexer.append( u )
            call EVUnitRemove.append( u )
            call EVUnitDamageEvent.append( u, function onEnemyDamaged )
            call EVDebuffSlow.append( u )
            //전처리
            if GetPanalty( PANALTY_ENEMY_BOOST ) then
                call UnitAddAbility( u , 'A03W' )
            endif
            //종결
            call UnitRemoveAbility( u, 'Avul' )
        endmethod
        static method dealLogic takes unit src, unit dst, real dmg, weapontype wpt, integer id returns nothing
            local integer p_id = DEAL_FLAG_LOGIC_ID
            local boolean p_attacking = DEAL_FLAG_ATTACKING
            local boolean p_logic = DEAL_FLAG_LOGIC
            local real reqmp = 0
            set DEAL_FLAG_LOGIC_ID = id
            set DEAL_FLAG_ATTACKING = false
            set DEAL_FLAG_LOGIC = true
            if IsUnitType(dst, UNIT_TYPE_GIANT) then
                set dmg = dmg * 0.1
            endif
            if GetUnitAbilityLevel(dst,'A0EX') == 0 then
                set reqmp = RMinBJ(dmg, GetUnitState(dst, UNIT_STATE_MANA))
            endif
            set dmg = RMaxBJ(0.01,dmg - reqmp)
            if dmg < 1.0 then
                call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Items\\SpellShieldAmulet\\SpellShieldCaster.mdl",dst,"origin"))
            endif
            call SetUnitState(dst, UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetUnitState(dst, UNIT_STATE_MANA) - reqmp)
            call UnitDamageTarget( src, dst, dmg, true, false, ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS, DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL, wpt )
            set DEAL_FLAG_LOGIC = p_logic
            set DEAL_FLAG_ATTACKING = p_attacking
            set DEAL_FLAG_LOGIC_ID = p_id
        endmethod

            endif
            if GetUnitAbilityLevel(dst,'A0EX') == 0 then

            endif
            if not penetr then
                set dmg = RMaxBJ(0.01,dmg - reqmp)
            endif
            if dmg < 1.0 then
                call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Items\\SpellShieldAmulet\\SpellShieldCaster.mdl",dst,"origin"))
            endif
            if addit then
                call SetUnitState(dst, UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetUnitState(dst, UNIT_STATE_MANA) - reqmp)
            endif
            call UnitDamageTarget( src, dst, dmg, true, false, ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS, DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL, wpt )
            set DEAL_FLAG_LOGIC = p_logic
            set DEAL_FLAG_ATTACKING = p_attacking
            set DEAL_FLAG_LOGIC_ID = p_id
        endmethod

    private function main takes nothing returns nothing
        set warnTick = tick.create(0)

    private function onLifeWarn takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer i = 0
        local real x
        local real y
        local integer lif
        local integer need = 0
        loop
            exitwhen i == 4
            if USER_IS_PLAYING[i] and USER_USE_WARNPING[i] then
                set lif = GetUserLife(Player(i))
                if lif <= 0 then
                    set need = need + 1
                    set x = GetPlayerStartLocationX(Player(i))
                    set y = GetPlayerStartLocationY(Player(i))
                    if GetLocalPlayer() == Player(i) then
                        call StopSound(gg_snd_WarnPing, false, false)
                        call StartSound(gg_snd_WarnPing)
                        call PingMinimapEx(x,y,2.00,255,0,0,false)
                        call PingMinimapEx(x,y,2.00,255,0,0,true)
                    endif
                endif
            endif
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
        if need > 0 then
            call warnTick.start( 0.20, false, function onLifeWarn )
            return
        endif
        set warnerRunning = false
    endfunction
    private function RefreshLifeWarn takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer i = 0
        local integer lif
        local integer warn = 40
        if FXRD_UNION_LIFE then
            set warn = warn * CountInGameUser()
        endif
        if GetPanalty(PANALTY_ENEMY_BONUS) then
            set warn = warn * 2
        endif
        loop
            exitwhen i == 4
            if USER_IS_PLAYING[i] then
                set lif = GetUserLife(Player(i))
                if lif > warn then
                    call SetPlayerState( Player(i), PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_FOOD_USED, 100 )
                elseif lif > 0 then
                    call SetPlayerState( Player(i), PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_FOOD_USED, 20 )
                else
                    call SetPlayerState( Player(i), PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_FOOD_USED, 0 )
                    if not warnerRunning then
                        set warnerRunning = true
                        call warnTick.start( 0.20, false, function onLifeWarn )
                    endif
                endif
            endif
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
    endfunction
    function AddUserLife takes player p, integer i returns nothing
        local integer id = GetPlayerId(p)
        set FXRD_LIFE[id] = FXRD_LIFE[id] + i
        if FXRD_UNION_LIFE then
            set FXRD_LIFE[11] = FXRD_LIFE[11] + i

library FXClanupUser requires FXLife

    private function TestAllCleanup takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer i = 0
        loop
            exitwhen i == 4
            if USER_IS_PLAYING[i] then
                return
            endif
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
        // 게임이 종료되었음을 명시

        //공용 소유의 유닛 제거

    function CleanupUser takes player p returns nothing

        if not USER_IS_PLAYING[id] then
            return
        endif
        //더 이상 게임에 영향을 끼치지 못하게 됨을 명시
        set USER_IS_PLAYING[id] = false
        //자기 소유의 모든 유닛 제거
        call sweep( p )
        //자기 소유(+4)의 모든 유닛 제거
        call sweep( Player(id+4) )
        //자원 제거
        call SetPlayerState( p, PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD, 0 )
        call SetPlayerState( p, PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER, 0 )
        //자기 라이프 소멸
        call AddUserLife( p, -FXRD_LIFE[id] )
        //현황판 - 플레이어 내림
        call statusBoard.removePlayer( p )
        //작업 마침 - 소실 메시지 출력
        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer( GetLocalPlayer(), 0, 0, 30.00, pcs[id]+GetPlayerName(p)+"|r님이 |c00D040D0허수 처리|r 되었습니다!")
        //패배 처리
        call RRRequestPlayer( REQUEST_GAME_PLAYER_DEFEAT, p )
        /*call FXRDVictory( p, false ) (구 승패결정기, 다음에 보면 지울 것)*/
        //남은 플레이어가 없으면 공용 모두 제거
        call TestAllCleanup()
    endfunction
endlibrary

    globals

    private function main takes nothing returns nothing

        set spawnY[1] = -960
        set spawnX[2] = 960

    struct roundWave
        //
        private tick myWaveTick
        private tickUI myWaveTickUI
        private tick mySpawnTick
        private player myOwner
        private player myEnemy
        private player myWaveStack
        //
        private integer myRound
        private integer mySpawnCount
        private integer mySpawnCountMax
        private boolean imWorking
        //====================================================================
        static method create takes player p, player e, player w,  integer r, string s returns thistype
            local thistype this = thistype.allocate()
            local real spawnFullTime = 2.00 / 3.00
            local integer uid
            set ENEMY_WAVE_STACK[GetPlayerId(w)] = ENEMY_WAVE_STACK[GetPlayerId(w)] + 1
            set ENEMY_WAVE_WORKING[GetPlayerId(w)] = ENEMY_WAVE_WORKING[GetPlayerId(w)] + 1
            set .imWorking = true
            //
            if FXRD_ROUND_ID[r] == 0 then
                if ModuloInteger(r, 10) == 0 then
                    set FXRD_ROUND_ID[r] = RNUID[0]
                    set FXRD_ROUND_MOV[r] = MOVID[0]
                else
                    set uid = GetRandomInt(1,MAX_UNIT_TYPE)
                    set FXRD_ROUND_ID[r] = RNUID[uid]
                    set FXRD_ROUND_MOV[r] = MOVID[uid]
                endif
            endif
            if MODE_CURRENT == MODE_SPEEDRUN then
                set spawnFullTime = 0.25
            endif
            //
            set .myOwner = p
            set .myEnemy = e
            set .myWaveStack = w
            set .myRound = r
            set .myWaveTick = tick.create( this )
            call .myWaveTick.start( LEVEL_TIMEOUT[LEVEL_CURRENT], false, function thistype.onRoundExpireA )
            set .myWaveTickUI = tickUI.create( .myWaveTick )
            set .myWaveTickUI.title = s
            set .myWaveTickUI.visible = GetLocalPlayer() == p
            set .mySpawnTick = tick.create( this )
            set .mySpawnCount = 0
            if GetPanalty(PANALTY_ENEMY_BONUS) then
                set .mySpawnCountMax = 80
                call .mySpawnTick.start( LEVEL_TIMEOUT[LEVEL_CURRENT] * spawnFullTime / .mySpawnCountMax, true, function thistype.onSpawnExpire )
            else
                set .mySpawnCountMax = 40
                call .mySpawnTick.start( LEVEL_TIMEOUT[LEVEL_CURRENT] * spawnFullTime / .mySpawnCountMax, true, function thistype.onSpawnExpire )
            endif
            return this
        endmethod
        //====================================================================
        method destroy takes nothing returns nothing
            set ENEMY_WAVE_STACK[GetPlayerId(.myWaveStack)] = ENEMY_WAVE_STACK[GetPlayerId(.myWaveStack)] - 1
            call .myWaveTickUI.destroy()
            call .myWaveTick.destroy()
            call .mySpawnTick.destroy()
            set .myOwner = null
            set .myEnemy = null
            set .myWaveStack = null
            //
            call .deallocate()
        endmethod
        //====================================================================
        
        private static method onRoundExpireA takes nothing returns nothing
            local thistype this = tick.getExpired().data
            //라이프 체크
            if GetUserLife( .myOwner ) <= 0 then
                call CleanupUser( .myOwner )
            endif
            if .imWorking then
                set .imWorking = false
                set ENEMY_WAVE_WORKING[GetPlayerId(.myWaveStack)] = ENEMY_WAVE_WORKING[GetPlayerId(.myWaveStack)] - 1
            endif
            //해제
            call .destroy()
        endmethod
        private static method onSkipCheck takes nothing returns nothing
            local thistype this = tick.getExpired().data
            local integer id = GetPlayerId(.myOwner)
            if ENEMY_REMAIN[GetPlayerId(.myEnemy)] > 0 then
                return
            endif
            if .imWorking then
                set .imWorking = false
                set ENEMY_WAVE_WORKING[GetPlayerId(.myWaveStack)] = ENEMY_WAVE_WORKING[GetPlayerId(.myWaveStack)] - 1
                set .myWaveTickUI.title = "동맹 대기 중..."
            endif
            if ENEMY_WAVE_WORKING[GetPlayerId(.myWaveStack)] == 0 then
                call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer( .myOwner, 0.00, 0.00, 10, "|c0000ff00남은 시간 스킵|r" )
                call .mySpawnTick.pause()
                call .myWaveTick.start( 0.1, false, function thistype.onRoundExpireA )
            endif
        endmethod
        private static method onSpawnExpire takes nothing returns nothing
            local thistype this = tick.getExpired().data
            local integer id = GetPlayerId(.myOwner)
            local real x = GetPlayerStartLocationX(.myOwner)
            local real y = GetPlayerStartLocationY(.myOwner)
            local integer hp = R2Rhp(.myRound)
            local integer mp = R2Rmp(.myRound)
            local integer bounty = 0
            local unit u
            if not USER_IS_PLAYING[id] then
                return
            endif
            //공통 -사살 보상금 반영
            if ModuloInteger(.myRound,10) == 0 then
                set bounty = IMaxBJ(1, .myRound * 2)
            else
                set bounty = IMaxBJ(1, .myRound / 2)
            endif
            //보상금 반영 끝
            if FXRD_UNION_LINE then
                set u = CreateUnit(.myEnemy, FXRD_ROUND_ID[.myRound], x + spawnX[id], y + spawnY[id], 270)
            else
                set u = CreateUnit(.myEnemy, FXRD_ROUND_ID[.myRound], x-960, y+960, 270)
            endif
            //패널티 - 공세의 첫 번째 유닛 강화(40배)
            if .mySpawnCount == 0 and GetPanalty(PANALTY_POWERFUL_LEADER) then
                call UnitAddAbility( u , 'A0EW' )
                set hp = hp * 20
                set mp = mp * 20
                set bounty = bounty * 10
            else
                //패널티 - 적이 두배면 체력이 절반, 보상금도 절반
                if GetPanalty(PANALTY_ENEMY_BONUS) then
                    set hp = hp / 2
                    set mp = mp / 2
                    set bounty = IMaxBJ(1,bounty / 2)
                endif
            endif
            //패널티 적용 끝
            call lifeMod.apply( u, R2I(hp * LEVEL_HP[LEVEL_CURRENT]) )
            call manaMod.apply( u, R2I(mp * LEVEL_HP[LEVEL_CURRENT]) )
            call AddEnemyRemain( .myEnemy, 1 )
            call enemy.add( .myEnemy, u )
            if GetPanalty( PANALTY_ENEMY_HEAL ) then
                call UnitAddAbility( u , 'A04J' )
                call EVStateRegenerate.append( u, GetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE) * 0.005, GetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA) * 0.01 )
            else
                call EVStateRegenerate.append( u, 0.00, GetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA) * 0.01 )
            endif
            call EVDeathBounty.append( u, bounty, .myOwner )
            if FXRD_UNION_LINE then
                call EVSquareMovement.append( u, ROUTE_LANE_TEAM[id], FXRD_ROUND_MOV[.myRound] )
            else
                call EVSquareMovement.append( u, ROUTE_LANE[id], FXRD_ROUND_MOV[.myRound] )
            endif
            set u = null
            set .mySpawnCount = .mySpawnCount + 1
            if .mySpawnCount == .mySpawnCountMax then
                call .mySpawnTick.start(1.0, true, function thistype.onSkipCheck)
            endif
        endmethod
    endstruct
endlibrary

library FXRound requires FXWisp, FXFieldTooltips
    //이 객체가 Wave를 굴리면서 모든 문제가 시작됩니다.
    globals
        private tick ROUND_DELAYER
        private tickUI ROUND_DELAYER_UI
        
        private tick array ROUND
    endglobals
    
    private function giveWispBounty takes player p returns nothing
        local integer wispBounty = 3
        local integer i = 0
        if FXRD_UNION_WAVE then
            if GetPanalty(PANALTY_LESS_WISP) then
                if p == Player(11) then
                    call DisplayTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(),0,0,"|c00FF4040『하나가 부족해!』 효과 발동!|r")
                else
                    call DisplayTextToPlayer(p,0,0,"|c00FF4040『하나가 부족해!』 효과 발동!|r")
                endif
                set wispBounty = wispBounty - 1
            endif
            loop
                exitwhen i == 4
                if USER_IS_PLAYING[i] then
                    call CreateWisp( Player(i), wispBounty )
                endif
                set i = i + 1
            endloop
        else
            call CreateWisp( p, wispBounty )
        endif
    endfunction
    
    private function runWave takes player p, player ep returns nothing
        local integer i = 0
        local integer wav = GetUserWave(p)
        local string wavePrefix = "웨이브 " + I2S(wav)
        if wav == LEVEL_WAVE[LEVEL_CURRENT] - 1 then
            set wavePrefix = "|c00B040B0최종 웨이브|r"
        endif
        if FXRD_UNION_WAVE then
            loop
                exitwhen i == 4
                if USER_IS_PLAYING[i] then
                    if not FXRD_UNION_LINE then
                        set ep = Player(i+4)
                    endif
                    call roundWave.create( Player(i), ep, Player(11), wav, wavePrefix)
                endif
                set i = i + 1
            endloop
        else
            call roundWave.create( p, ep, ep, wav, wavePrefix + " : " + pcs[GetPlayerId(p)] + "PLAYER "+ I2S(GetPlayerId(p)))
        endif
    endfunction
    
    private function onRoundStartSpeedrun takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick t = tick.getExpired()
        local integer myId = t.data
        local integer enemyId = myId + 4
        local integer enemyHp
        local integer rnd
        if not USER_IS_PLAYING[myId] or FXRD_WAVE[myId] == LEVEL_WAVE[LEVEL_CURRENT] then
            //타이머 완전파괴!
            call t.destroy()
            return
        endif
        if ENEMY_WAVE_STACK[enemyId] > 0 then
            return
        endif
        set rnd = GetUserWave(Player(myId)) + 1
        call SetUserWave( Player(myId), rnd)
        if FXRD_WAVE[myId] < LEVEL_WAVE[LEVEL_CURRENT] then
            call runWave( Player(myId), Player(enemyId) )
            set enemyHp = R2I(R2Rhp(rnd) * LEVEL_HP[LEVEL_CURRENT])
            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(Player(myId),0,0,20,"|c00FF4040웨이브 "+I2S(rnd)+" : "+GetObjectName(FXRD_ROUND_ID[rnd])+" (내구 "+I2S(enemyHp)+")|r")
        endif
        call eventCustom.evaluate( EVENT_GAME_ROUND, Player(myId), null, null, 0 )
        call giveWispBounty( Player(myId) )
        //툴팁 새로고침
        call RefreshFieldTooltip()
        call statusBoard.refreshWave()
    endfunction
    private function onRoundStart takes nothing returns nothing
        local tick t = tick.getExpired()
        local integer myId = t.data
        local integer enemyId = 11
        local integer rnd
        if not GAME_IS_PLAYING or FXRD_WAVE[myId] == LEVEL_WAVE[LEVEL_CURRENT] then
            //타이머 완전파괴!
            call t.destroy()
            return
        endif
        if ENEMY_WAVE_STACK[enemyId] > 0 then
            return
        endif
        set rnd = GetUserWave(Player(myId)) + 1
        call SetUserWave( Player(myId), rnd)
        if FXRD_WAVE[myId] < LEVEL_WAVE[LEVEL_CURRENT] then
            call runWave( Player(myId), Player(enemyId) )
            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(),0,0,20,"|c00FF4040웨이브 "+I2S(rnd)+" : "+GetObjectName(FXRD_ROUND_ID[rnd])+" (내구 "+I2S(R2I(R2Rhp(rnd)*LEVEL_HP[LEVEL_CURRENT]))+")|r")
        endif
        call eventCustom.evaluate( EVENT_GAME_ROUND, Player(myId), null, null, 0 )
        call giveWispBounty( Player(myId) )
        //툴팁 새로고침
        call RefreshFieldTooltip()
    endfunction
    
    private function initRoundStart takes nothing returns nothing
        call ROUND_DELAYER_UI.destroy()
        call ROUND_DELAYER.destroy()
        if FXRD_UNION_WAVE then
            set ROUND[11] = tick.create(11)
            call ROUND[11].start( 1.00, true, function onRoundStart )
        else
            set ROUND[0] = tick.create(0)
            set ROUND[1] = tick.create(1)
            set ROUND[2] = tick.create(2)
            set ROUND[3] = tick.create(3)
            call ROUND[0].start( 1.00, true, function onRoundStartSpeedrun )
            call ROUND[1].start( 1.00, true, function onRoundStartSpeedrun )
            call ROUND[2].start( 1.00, true, function onRoundStartSpeedrun )
            call ROUND[3].start( 1.00, true, function onRoundStartSpeedrun )
        endif
    endfunction
    
    function StartGameRound takes nothing returns nothing
        set ROUND_DELAYER = tick.create(0)
        call ROUND_DELAYER.start( 20, false, function initRoundStart )
        set ROUND_DELAYER_UI = tickUI.create( ROUND_DELAYER )
        set ROUND_DELAYER_UI.title = "게임 시작까지..."
        set ROUND_DELAYER_UI.visible = true
    endfunction

scope FXtryjohab initializer main
    globals
        private integer array LASTJOHAB
        private tick array JOHABCUT
    endglobals
    private function onFreeJohab takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer id = tick.getExpired().data
        set LASTJOHAB[id] = 0
    endfunction
    //오브젝트 에디터 - 능력 오브젝트의 그림(A)-스페셜 항목에 기재된 태그를 읽어들인 다음, 일치하는 플래그를 세웁니다.
    private function FlagJohabAbility takes integer id returns nothing
        local integer i = 0
        local string s = "ends"
        local string ts = null
        call FXClearJohabFlags()
        if GetAbilityEffectById( id, EFFECT_TYPE_SPECIAL, 0 ) == null then
            return
        endif
        loop
            set ts = GetAbilityEffectById( id, EFFECT_TYPE_SPECIAL, i )
            exitwhen ts == null
            exitwhen ts == s
            set s = ts
            call FXSetJohabFlag( StringHash(ts) )
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
    endfunction
        private function onCast takes nothing returns nothing
            local player p
            local unit u
            local real x
            local real y
            local integer lev
            local string oldname
            local integer id = GetSpellAbilityId()
            local integer pid = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer( GetSpellAbilityUnit() ))
            if GetObjectName( id ) != "[조합]" then
                return
            endif
            //이 조합식에 대한 특수 플래그를 등록합니다.
            call FlagJohabAbility( id )
            set p = Player(pid)
            //플래그 FLAG_UNIQUE가 존재한다면, 이미 보유한 개체인지 확인합니다.
            if FXGetJohabFlag(JOHAB_FLAG_UNIQUE) then
                if servant.count( p, S2A(GetAbilityEffectById( id, EFFECT_TYPE_TARGET, 0 )) ) > 0 then
                    call DisplayTextToPlayer( p, 0.00, 0.00, "|c00ff0000이 서번트는 더 이상 조합할 수 없습니다|r" )
                    call StartSoundForPlayerBJ( p, gg_snd_Error )
                    call IssueImmediateOrder( GetTriggerUnit(), "holdposition" )
                    set p = null
                    return
                endif
            endif
            //중복조합 방지
            if LASTJOHAB[pid] == id then
                return
            endif
            set LASTJOHAB[pid] = id
            call JOHABCUT[pid].start( 0.03125, false, function onFreeJohab )
            //구현 끝
            set u = GetTriggerUnit()
            if Johab.recipeChk( p, id, servant.getOriginalType(p, u) ) then
                set x = GetUnitX( u )
                set y = GetUnitY( u )
                call servant.remove( p, u )
                call KillUnit( u )
                call ShowUnit( u , false )
                call Johab.try( p, u, id )
                //
                set u = CreateUnit( p, S2A(GetAbilityEffectById(id,EFFECT_TYPE_TARGET,0)), x, y, 270.00 )
                if FXFireUnitBeforeJohabEvent( u ) then
                    call servant.add( p, u, servant.JOHAB )
                    if GetUnitLevel(u) < 5 then
                        call DestroyEffect( AddSpecialEffect("FX\\johabTarget.mdl",GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u)) )
                    else
                        call DestroyEffect( AddSpecialEffect("FX\\Nero\\Ultimate.mdl",GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u)) )
                    endif
                endif
            else
                if FXGetJohabFlag(JOHAB_FLAG_HIDDEN) then
                    call DisplayTextToPlayer( p, 0.00, 0.00, "|c00FF0000성배 개방 조건을 충족하지 못했습니다|r" )
                else
                    call DisplayTextToPlayer( p, 0.00, 0.00, "|c00FF0000서번트가 부족합니다 : "+trimmer.get(Johab.ERRORCODE)+"|r" )

scope FXGather initializer main
    globals
        private constant integer ABIL = 'gath'
        private group G = CreateGroup()
        private integer ID
        private real X = 0
        private real Y = 0
    endglobals
    private function onFilter takes nothing returns boolean
        if GetUnitTypeId( GetFilterUnit() ) != ID then
            return false
        endif
        if GetUnitAbilityLevel( GetFilterUnit(), ABIL ) == 0 then
            return false
        endif
        call SetUnitPosition( GetFilterUnit(), X, Y )
        call SetUnitX( GetFilterUnit(), X )
        call SetUnitY( GetFilterUnit(), Y )
        call IssueImmediateOrder( GetFilterUnit(), "holdposition" )
        return false
    endfunction

        set ID = GetUnitTypeId( GetTriggerUnit() )
        set X = GetUnitX( GetTriggerUnit() )
        set Y = GetUnitY( GetTriggerUnit() )
        call GroupEnumUnitsOfPlayer( G, GetOwningPlayer( GetTriggerUnit() ), Filter( function onFilter ) )
        call GroupClear( G )
    endfunction
    private function main takes nothing returns nothing
        call AbilityEffectEvent.Create( ABIL, function cast )
    endfunction
endscope

scope PLAYtryreverse initializer main
    globals
        private integer array LASTREVERSE
        private tick array REVERSECUT
    endglobals
    private function onFreeReverse takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer id = tick.getExpired().data
        set LASTREVERSE[id] = 0
    endfunction

    private function onCast takes nothing returns nothing
            local player p
            local unit u
            local integer id = GetSpellAbilityId()
            local integer pid = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer( GetSpellAbilityUnit() ))
            if GetObjectName( id ) != "[분해]" then
                return
            endif
            //중복조합 방지
            if LASTREVERSE[pid] == id then
                return
            endif
            set LASTREVERSE[pid] = id
            call REVERSECUT[pid].start( 0.03125, false, function onFreeReverse )
            //구현 끝
            set p = GetOwningPlayer( GetSpellAbilityUnit() )
            set u = GetSpellAbilityUnit()
            if GetRandomReal( 0.00, 100.00 ) < S2I(GetAbilityEffectById( id, EFFECT_TYPE_LIGHTNING, 0 )) then
                call DisplayTextToPlayer( p, 0.00, 0.00, GetAbilityEffectById( id, EFFECT_TYPE_TARGET, 0 ) )
                call JohabReverse.disAssemble( p, id, GetUnitX(u), GetUnitY(u) )
            else
                call DisplayTextToPlayer( p, 0.00, 0.00, GetAbilityEffectById( id, EFFECT_TYPE_TARGET, 1 ) )
                call DestroyEffect( AddSpecialEffect( "Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Undead\\UndeadDissipate\\UndeadDissipate.mdl", GetUnitX(u), GetUnitY(u) ) )
            endif
            call servant.remove( p, u )
            call KillUnit( u )
            call ShowUnit( u , false )
            set p = null
            set u = null
    endfunction

struct InterfaceNumpad
    private player myPlayer
    private string mdlPath
    private integer myLength
    private real myOffset
    private real myX
    private real myY
    private string myText
    private effect array myFx[31]
    static method create takes player p, real x, real y, string path, real off returns thistype
        local thistype this = thistype.allocate()
        set .myPlayer = p
        set .myX = x
        set .myY = y
        set .mdlPath = path
        set .myOffset = off
        set .myText = ""
        set .myLength = 0
        return this
    endmethod
    method clear takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer i = 0
        loop
            exitwhen i == .myLength
            call DestroyEffect(.myFx[i])
            set .myFx[i] = null
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
    endmethod
    method draw takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer i = 0
        local real x = .myX - (32*.myOffset* .myLength)
        call .clear()
        loop
            exitwhen i == .myLength
            set .myFx[i] = AddEffectForPlayer( .myPlayer, .mdlPath + SubString(.myText,i,i+1) + ".mdl", x+32*i, .myY  )
            set i = i + 1
        endloop
    endmethod
    method operator path= takes string s returns nothing
        call .clear()
        set .mdlPath = s
        call .draw()
    endmethod
    method operator text= takes string s returns nothing
        call .clear()
        set .myText = s
        set .myLength = StringLength(s)
        call .draw()
    endmethod
    method destroy takes nothing returns nothing
        call .clear()
        set .myPlayer = null
        call .deallocate( )
    endmethod
endstruct

        local unit src

        if not DEAL_FLAG_ATTACKING then
            return
        endif
        set src = GetTriggerUnit()

        call eventServantAdd.register( SV_ATALANTA + OFF_C, function onServantGet )
        call eventServantAdd.register( SV_ATALANTA + OFF_B, function onServantGet )
        call eventServantAdd.register( SV_ATALANTA + OFF_A, function onServantGet )
        call eventServantAdd.register( SV_ATALANTA + OFF_S, function onServantGet )

//prefer algebraic approach because of real subtraction issues
function log takes real y, real base returns real
    local real x
    local real factor = 1.0
    local real logy = 0.0
    local real sign = 1.0
    if(y < 0.) then
        return 0.0
    endif
    if(y < 1.) then
        set y = 1.0/y
        set sign = -1.0
    endif
    //Chop out powers of the base
    loop
        exitwhen y < 1.0001    //decrease this ( bounded below by 1) to improve precision
        if(y > base) then
            set y = y / base
            set logy = logy + factor
        else
            set base = SquareRoot(base)     //If you use just one base a lot, precompute its squareroots
            set factor = factor / 2.
        endif
    endloop
    return sign*logy
endfunction

private function prop_Log takes nothing returns boolean
    if not Test_Closeto(log(10,10),1) then
        return false
    elseif not Test_Closeto(log(10,2.7182818),2.302585) then

		if .next == 0 and .leaf == 0 then
			return true
		elseif .next != 0 and .next.Clean() then
			call .next.destroy()
			set .next = 0
			return .leaf == 0
		else

	endmethod

		local integer quotient

		if .next != 0 then

        set num = .leaf + remainder*base

		set remainder = num - quotient*denom
